title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI 

Role Overview 

Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect , redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a Developer Advocate and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.

This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.

As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.

Key Responsibilities 

End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization 

- Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.

- Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.

- Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.

- Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).

- Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.

- Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

Data & AI Infrastructure 

- Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.

- Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.

- Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.

- Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture 

- Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.

- Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.

- Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy 

- You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.

- You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.

- Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership 

- Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.

- Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.

- Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.

- Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.

- Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

Who You Are 

- Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.

- Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.

- System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.

- Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.

- Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.

- Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.

- Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

Must-Have Skills & Experience 

- 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.

- Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.

- Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.

- Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.

- Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.

- Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.

- Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).

- Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).

- Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.

- Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.

- Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

Nice-to-Have Skills 

- Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.

- Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.

- Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

Why Join Us? 

- Impact at scale —we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges .

- Modern technical foundation with room to innovate —leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.

- Hands-on architecture leadership —you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.

- Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts , pushing the limits of what’s possible.

- Competitive compensation and high ownership —your work will define how Jumio scales.

Jumio Values: 

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation 

Equal Opportunities : 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses. 

About Jumio: 

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

description:

About our Engineering Teams: 

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

How we work 💻 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life: 

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼 

You should apply if: 

- you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product

- you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day

- you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions

- you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity

- you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software

- you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).

- you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L40 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter! 

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you! 

What you’ll be working on: 

We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge , you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: 

- Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here )

- Cassandra for most persistent data storage

- Kafka for our asynchronous message queue

- Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services 

- Envoy Proxy for RPC

- AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure

- React for our public web apps and internal tools

- We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties

The Interview Process: 

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

- Initial Call 

- Take home task or pair coding exercise 

- Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview 

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here .

What’s in it for you: 

💰 £85,000 - £110,000 base salary + Incentive Awards tied to your performance 

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅ We can sponsor visas.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.

title: Senior AI Product Designer  (m/w/d)
description:
About Recare 

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer 

- You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet.

- You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones.

- You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production.

- You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on.

- You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against.

You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary.

- You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships.

You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it.

How we design:

- We're AI-native. We use AI tools daily in our own process, not just in what we design, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

- Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators.

- Human-in-the-loop by default. This is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and verification moments that make that real, not just a confidence score bolted on.

- We ship in production, not just in Figma. Craft is judged by what clinicians actually use, so we stay close to what ships.

What to expect as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

- Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

- Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

- Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

- Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

- Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

Here's how we picture you as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

- You have 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years operating at Senior, Principal, or Staff altitude. 

- You have designed for AI and non-determinism before, and can talk concretely about how you've communicated agent behaviour, handled errors, and kept users in control, not just in the abstract.

- You have owned or significantly contributed to a design system, at the level of patterns and principles rather than individual components.

- You are block-shaped: equally strong across UX process, UI craft, product thinking, research, storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration.

- You have taken features from 0 to 1 through an ambiguous problem statement to shipped code, and you're comfortable feeling like a PM or frontend developer on the days that calls for it.

- You have high agency and spot gaps without being asked to look for them, including outside your own product area.

- You hold a position under pressure but change it when new information warrants, rather than becoming precious about your own decisions.

- You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable operating in an international environment; German is a plus but not required.

- You bring a consumer-grade craft background with exceptional design; healthtech experience is a plus but not required.

- If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you

title: Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention . Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability. 

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France , and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries. 

This position is based in Rennes, France. 

Chance to apply closes: 6th of November 2026. 

The Solutions Engineer at IDnow is the client's trusted advisor through pre-sales and integration . You design the solution the client will rely on, you give them confidence that it will work in their environment, and you become the person they turn to for technical and solution decisions. Your focus is the technical side of the journey up to the point where the client is live on our products, and you make that path smooth . 

This is a hands-on, deeply technical role, and a commercial one . Solutions Engineers carry a quota and are measured on two things: the deals they help win, and whether the client goes live successfully. You work hand in hand with Sales to convince the client that our solution is the right one and to move them toward signature, and then you make sure they can use it well in production. You earn that through technical depth, but you are client-facing, credible and persuasive in a sales motion. You do this across our whole client base.

We hire this role at more than one level. The core of the job is the same; the scope you own and the complexity you handle grow with your experience. This role carries real ownership across the client journey, and a say in how the work evolves.

Key Responsibilities

Discover and Design

- Lead technical discovery, qualifying conversion rates, false acceptance and rejection trade-offs, fraud exposure and integration constraints before proposing a solution,

- Design end-to-end solution architectures that orchestrate document verification, digital identity, fraud signals, biometric authentication, eID and EU Digital Identity Wallet flows, and e-signature,

- Link every technical choice to the client’s business objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), so proposals speak to outcomes rather than features,

- Define defensible architecture decisions covering fallback logic, data residency, scalability and performance,

- Support Sales with proposals, Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), advising on which capabilities to combine and why.

Prove, Integrate and Go Live

- Lead proof-of-concept and pilot engagements, configuring Application Programming Interface (API) integrations, building Postman collections and managing sandbox environments,

- Validate behaviour under realistic conditions and document what the client needs to go live,

- Guide client developers through API and mobile Software Development Kit (SDK) integration, including webhooks, authentication and testing,

- Troubleshoot integration issues by reading logs and diagnosing failures at the API and SDK level, rather than only forwarding them,

- Maintain a living integration map of the client’s architecture, data flows and dependencies,

- Own the account from signature to go-live, running the go-live plan and handing a documented account to Customer Success and Support at the end of hypercare.

Advise and Enable

- Build trusted advisor relationships with business and technical stakeholders, from first conversation to go-live,

- Represent the client’s technical reality internally, feeding integration blockers, product gaps and pilot learnings back to Product and Sales teams,

- Work with the internal escalation team on deeper platform issues, arriving with clear technical context,

- Stand alongside Sales in client meetings, addressing objections on integration effort, feasibility and alternatives,

- Improve demo environments, architecture templates and integration guides, and mentor team members as the practice grows.

Preferred Experience

You ask before you propose and qualify before you demo, turning ambiguous client requirements into the right technical solution. You take ownership of the client’s technical path from first conversation to production, and you explain complex systems in plain language to engineers and business leaders alike. You combine hands-on engineering depth with a commercial mindset, and you enjoy working alongside Sales to move a decision forward.

- Engineering or technical degree , a Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience,

- 3+ years of experience in solutions engineering, technical consulting, or implementation and onboarding in SaaS , ideally in identity, FinTech or security,

- Discovery and qualification skills , with the ability to turn an ambiguous client requirement into the best technical solution,

- Solution architecture skills , including designing integration flows, explaining orchestration logic and defending trade-offs with a client’s engineers,

- Hands-on technical skills with APIs, Software Development Kits (SDKs) including mobile, and integration tooling such as Postman and Git,

- Experience running a proof of concept and debugging an integration at the API or log level,

- Delivery discipline to run an integration and onboarding through to a committed go-live date, managing several client projects at once,

- The ability to translate technical complexity into plain language and reassure non-technical stakeholders,

- Business value awareness , connecting the technical solution to client outcomes such as verification conversion, fraud loss or time to go-live,

- Client-facing presence, building trusted advisor relationships with business stakeholders such as Chief Digital Officers (CDOs) and Heads of Digital, and technical stakeholders such as Chief Technology Officers (CTOs), architects and platform engineers,

- The instinct to own the client’s technical path end to end,

- Fluent English and full professional French are both hard requirements for the role. Additional European languages are a plus.

Nice to Have 

- Familiarity with identity verification, Know Your Customer (KYC), Know Your Business (KYB) or Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes, including document verification, biometrics, liveness detection, eID and fraud detection,

- Interest in where digital identity is heading, including eIDAS 2.0, EU Digital Identity Wallets, the EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR),

- Experience with mobile SDK delivery on iOS, Android or React Native,

- Knowledge of web development concepts, including frontend and backend architecture, webhooks and Open Authorisation (OAuth),

- Experience in mobility, FinTech, banking or other regulated industries,

- Working knowledge of a programming language such as Python, Java or JavaScript, and of a cloud platform such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Perks & Benefits

- Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo , including 1on1 sessions.

- We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy , our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited content/course consumption incl. certification.

- We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours.

- We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect outside of work.

- May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefit of our paid special leave days. 

- Enjoy the possibility to combine work with a longer stay at your holiday destination or extend a weekend with our Workcation possibilities. 

- In addition to the perks & benefits above, we offer specific benefits that differ between our locations.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

- Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
- Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
- Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
- Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
- Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
- Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.
Hiring Process

- Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
- 15-minute phone screen
- First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Germany | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany. 

The opportunity: 

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team , a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product: 

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

- Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.

- Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.

- Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP) , Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.

- Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.

- Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

- AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant , which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing: 

- Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

- Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.

- Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust . Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.

- Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.

- Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.

- Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.

- Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.

- Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit: 

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

- Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.

- Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).

- Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.

- Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.

- Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.

- Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.

- Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For: 

- Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.

- A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.

- Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.

- Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.

- Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.

- Open source contribution or maintainership.

- Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards: 

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is € 100,000 - €125,000 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 

- 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

- Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

- Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

- Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

- In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 

- Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare.

Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be.

We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉

Your role

You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems.

This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan.

What you will be doing, among others:

- Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps.

- Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through.

- Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies.

- Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed.

- Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership.

- Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations.

- Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

- Salary : An annual maximum remuneration of approximately € 85.000 gross per year is estimated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii), depending on the interviews, your experience, background and knowledge.

- Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii .

- Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

- You have at least 5+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering and multiple years of hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code). 

- You are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks.

- You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you.

- You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries.

- You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

- English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now! 

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via 

What does the recruitment process look like? 

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

title: Frontend Software Engineer
description:
About Wayflyer 

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge 

When a founder logs into Wayflyer, what they see, and how easily they can make sense of it, directly affects whether they trust us with their business. We're building financial products that need to feel effortless.

What you'll actually do 

- 
Provide technical leadership in architectural decisions and champion our existing frontend best practices, advocating for our standards and helping push them forward across the team

- 
Lead the design and implementation of complex frontend features using TypeScript and React, ensuring high-quality, reusable components that scale across our financial products

Partner with product and design teams to shape product outcomes, defining intuitive experiences that help e-commerce brands access and manage their funding. This goes beyond delivering UI; every engineer here plays a meaningful role in what we build and how it serves our customers

- 
Own end-to-end delivery: shape solutions with product/design, build and test, ship to production and monitor/iterate using our observability stack.

- 
Drive improvements in performance, accessibility, and user experience across our platform

- 
Mentor engineers across the team and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain high quality standards

- 
Work closely alongside our backend engineers, contributing across the stack when needed. We actively encourage curiosity and flexibility about where you can add value

- 
Lead technical discussions and contribute to the team's technical strategy

- 
Identify and proactively address technical debt and system scalability challenges

Who thrives here 

You should be comfortable making and defending technical decisions, while remaining open to feedback and alternative approaches. You'll need to balance technical excellence with business needs and help guide the team toward pragmatic solutions.

You excel at stakeholder management and can effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences. You're proactive in identifying and addressing potential issues before they become problems. We look for candidates with most or all of the below traits that can point to real experience applying them.

- 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience

- 
5+ years of experience with deep expertise in frontend development

- 
Advanced proficiency in TypeScript and extensive experience with React and modern frontend architectures

- 
Expert knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript fundamentals with a focus on performance optimisation

- 
Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and managing complex state, including hands-on experience with TanStack Query

- 
Experience contributing to and working with design systems

- 
Familiarity with backend technologies (Python, Django) and a willingness to contribute across the stack. This isn’t a hard requirement, but that flexibility matters to us.

- 
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (especially GitHub Actions) and maintaining high-quality testing practices using tools like Storybook/Chromatic, Playwright, and Vitest

- 
Proven track record of leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineers

- 
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex problems

- 
Excellent communication abilities and experience managing stakeholder relationships

Given what we do, experience in financial services, fintech and business-to-business organisations is particularly interesting to us. 

We hire for range 

What you're like as a person and how you treat people is a big deal for us. People love working with you. You're helpful and generous with your time and knowledge. People love helping you back. People know where they stand with you.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

- Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.

Strongly preferred qualifications

- Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

title: Backend Engineer - Platform Core
description:
Backend Engineer (Golang) – Platform Core 

Location: Remote, European time zones, Full-time, Permanent

About FullEnrich: 

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem with waterfall enrichment: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted B2B data layer powering modern revenue teams and AI-driven workflows alike. Today, more than 5,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

About the Role: 

At the heart of FullEnrich is our waterfall engine. It's the system responsible for deciding which data providers to call, in what order, under which conditions, and what happens when something fails. It works well today, but what we're building next is significantly more ambitious.

We're evolving the engine to become far more flexible and configurable, supporting account-specific requirements, dynamic routing based on different optimization goals, and seamless integration of new providers and behaviors without introducing unnecessary complexity.

This is a foundational part of our product, and getting the architecture right is critical to how we scale.

We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and taking ownership of the systems behind them.

If you've built high-throughput routing systems, designed multi-provider orchestration layers, or worked on infrastructure that needs to adapt to different customers and use cases, this is exactly the kind of challenge you'll be taking on.

What You'll Do: 

- Own and evolve our core routing engine: Take ownership of provider selection, fallback logic, load balancing, and queue management. Our waterfall currently operates as a modular Go monolith, and you'll help evolve it to support account-level customization at scale without introducing unnecessary complexity.

- Build and improve provider integrations: Design how we connect to and manage third-party data providers, focusing on rate limiting, reliability, and observability. This includes supporting external provider credentials, configurable provider ordering, and well-defined fallback behavior when providers are unavailable.

- Develop intelligent routing capabilities: Build the logic that dynamically selects providers based on different optimization objectives, including speed, coverage, compliance, and intelligent load balancing, while managing rate limits effectively.

- Design scalable multi-tenant architecture: Develop the foundations for sub-accounts, customer-specific credit pools, and endpoint-level configuration, ensuring the engine remains flexible, scalable, and maintainable.

- Build composable verification workflows: Integrate validity and compliance checks into the enrichment pipeline as configurable steps, allowing results to be independently verified regardless of their original data source.

- Strengthen our core architecture: Improve and refactor existing systems as we scale, applying strong engineering practices to keep our codebase clean, understandable, reliable, and easy to maintain.

- Shape technical decisions: Work closely with our engineering leadership to translate product requirements into thoughtful architectural solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability.

What Success Looks Like 

In your first 3 months: 

- Develop a deep understanding of our existing waterfall engine, provider integrations, and core backend architecture.

- Build strong relationships with the engineering team and identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.

- Start contributing to the evolution of our routing engine, taking ownership of initial architectural improvements and technical decisions.

By 6 months: 

- Take ownership of key components of our core platform, delivering meaningful improvements to provider orchestration, fallback logic, and routing capabilities.

- Help introduce more flexible, account-level configuration while keeping the architecture clean, scalable, and maintainable.

- Improve the reliability and observability of our provider integrations, reducing operational complexity as we scale.

By 12 months: 

- Play a leading role in delivering a more intelligent, configurable waterfall engine that supports different customer needs and optimization goals at scale.

- Establish robust architectural foundations for multi-tenancy, composable verification, and continued provider expansion.

- Be a trusted technical contributor within the engineering team, helping shape long-term architectural decisions and ensuring our core platform remains reliable, performant, and ready for future growth.

What We're Looking For: 

- Strong backend engineering experience: You've built and maintained production systems involving routing, fallback mechanisms, queues, concurrency, and rate limiting. You understand how distributed and multi-provider systems behave under pressure and how to design for reliability.

- An architecture-first mindset: You're comfortable taking a product requirement, identifying potential structural challenges, and designing solutions that will stand the test of time. You think beyond implementation and consider scalability, maintainability, and long-term impact.

- Deep experience with Golang: Go is at the core of our backend. You're confident working with modular architectures, clean code principles, and ideally hexagonal architecture.

- Experience managing technical complexity: You can navigate systems with multiple interconnected components, from account-level configuration and provider orchestration to compliance workflows and multi-tenancy, without compromising clarity or simplicity.

- Strong ownership and problem-solving skills: You're proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable making technical decisions. You enjoy getting into the details, understanding why systems behave the way they do, and finding solutions to challenging engineering problems.

- A collaborative approach: You communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and enjoy working with other engineers to build reliable, high-quality systems.

Nice to Have 

- Experience with data routing, enrichment pipelines, or multi-provider orchestration systems.

- Experience building API marketplace infrastructure or multi-tenant SaaS backends.

- Familiarity with API-first product architectures.

- An interest in the evolving data infrastructure landscape.

Our Tech Stack 

Our backend is built primarily in Golang , following a modular, hexagonal architecture.

Our wider stack includes:

- Backend: Go (Golang)

- Databases & Search: PostgreSQL, OpenSearch

- Infrastructure: DigitalOcean, Docker

- CI/CD: GitHub Actions

- Monitoring & Observability: Grafana

You'll be joining an engineering team of around 10 people, working on one of the most critical components of our platform.

Interview Process

title: QA Automation Lead
description:
Role: QA Automation Lead

Location: London, Bristol

Level: C3

Team: Quality

Contract: Permanent 

Reporting To: Senior QA Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. 

About Kaluza 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do 

The QA Automation Leads are part of a leadership team and they work closely with QA Leads and Staff Engineers to enable Development Engineers to test the code that they produce.

The QA Automation Leads will be an authority on test data creation, test tools, and test automation best practice. They will coach Engineers through test automation, provision tools, and automate controls to ensure the quality of code delivered to client-facing teams and clients.

They will work with the Quality Enablement Team to embed automation frameworks, as well as automation that will audit AI generated code and tests. They will be the conduit between Engineering teams using these tools and the Enablement Team.

The QA Automation Leads will support QA professionals in the Forward Deployed Engineering Teams in the creation and validation of End to End tests that involve their domains.

- Coach and enable development engineers to write automated tests at service and domain level, and to test their own products and solutions.

- Provide the tooling for creating test data, building test automation and reporting test results.

- Partner with QA and development engineers in Forward Deployed Engineering teams to define and implement automated handovers between teams, and support their end-to-end testing.

- Implement innovative automation of testing, defect management and release processes for Global Product Teams, using AI where it adds value.

- Work with the Enablement Team to build intelligent automated testing solutions (such as testing the tests) and roll them out. 

- Use AI tools and techniques to build, refine and scale internal testing tools and frameworks, and build AI-driven tools that remove bottlenecks in code and architecture and speed up test-and-deploy cycles.

- Lead by example as a technical leader: champion best practice in test automation, AI code validation and agent tooling, write clean, testable code, perform code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior engineers.

What you’ll bring 

- Experience building, maintaining and enhancing test automation frameworks, using tools and languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright or Cypress.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals (design patterns, API design, data structures) in Python, TypeScript or similar, with experience automating tests using APIs.

- Knowledge of improving test data management, users and scenarios for ease of testing, and of working with developers to review automated unit and integration tests.

- Previous management experience, leading and coaching engineers across test cases

- A solid understanding of the SDLC, Agile methology and QA process.

- Experience using AI tools, such as LLM-based coding assistants and agent frameworks, as part of a pipeline, along with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques (faithfulness, relevance, LLM-as-a-judge), since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to AI agent testing.

- Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to collaborate with multiple stakeholders towards a common goal.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a solution-oriented mindset, with the willingness to speak up, highlight areas for improvement and suggest solutions.

Nice to have 

- Experience building or integrating AI agents, such as LangChain, AutoGen, custom agent frameworks or MCP-based tooling.

- Experience working with or testing AI-generated code, models or agents, covering both deterministic validation (is the generated code correct?) and non-deterministic evaluation (is the AI’s behaviour acceptable?).

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

- Knowledgade of Jira and test management tools such as XRay.

Our Values 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

- Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

- Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

- Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

- Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

- Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks 

- Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

- Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

- Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

- Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

- Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees. This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs live. 

What you'll do: 

Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first) 

- Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.

- Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.

- Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.

- Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.

User lifecycle and identity

- Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.

- Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.

- Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.

Scripting and automation

- Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.

- Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.

Security incident response

- Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.

- Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.

- Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.

IT support

- Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.

- Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.

- Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.

Platforms you will administer

These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.

Area

Platforms

Cloud infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)

Identity, HR and devices

Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth

Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)

Zoom, Aircall, Twilio

Data and engineering

Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch

AI platforms

Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)

Collaboration and design

Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe

Security tools

NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)

Healthcare operations

Waystar, AdvancedMD

Marketing and recruiting

Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn

About you: 

- 3+ years administering SaaS and cloud platforms in a company of 50–500 people, including Google Workspace and an identity/HR platform like Rippling or Okta, and ideally AWS.

- Hands-on experience configuring SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, MFA policies and role-based access.

- Working knowledge of audit logging and log review: you know what a CloudTrail event, a Workspace audit log or a Zendesk audit entry looks like and what to do with it.

- Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell or Bash, and comfort calling REST APIs.

- Experience responding to security incidents (phishing, compromised accounts, lost devices) and documenting what happened.

- Strong IT support instincts: you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and close tickets fast.

- Familiarity with HIPAA or a comparable compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and what it means for access control and logging.

Nice to have:

- AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.

- Experience with a SIEM or log aggregation tool (Datadog, Splunk, Google SecOps, or similar) and writing detection rules.

- MDM experience (Rippling, Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and macOS/Windows endpoint hardening.

- Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for managing AWS and SaaS configuration.

- Prior work in a healthcare or other regulated company.

- Experience administering API usage and keys for AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI) and setting spend and access controls.
