- Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline

- 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows

- Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic

- Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes

- Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 

- Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows

- Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence

- Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering

- Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

- 
Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

- 
Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

- 
Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With: 

- Python

- Redshift, PostgreSQL

- Data build tool (dbt) 

- WS, G Suite, Mac

- Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process: 

- Application submitted (you are here)

- Interview with recruiters (30 min)

- Offer

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend | Product Engineering
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Frontend Engineer to join a small but fast-growing Frontend Engineering team that is responsible for building highly robust and seamless product features that analyze blockchain transaction activity at a massive scale. As an early member of the team, you will be deeply involved in the technical details and ultimately champion your team to build a safer financial system for billions of people.

The impact you’ll have here: 

- 
Building a large-scale web application that manages billions of transactions using React and Redux

- 
Working with Backend Engineers, Designers, and Product to build features and ship product

- 
Finding and addressing performance issues

- 
Participating in code and design reviews

- 
Developing a deep understanding of crypto and blockchain to inform product design and direction

Collaborating with product lead and customers to define a new category of enterprise software

- 
Staying current on frontend best practices

What we’re looking for: 

- 
Knack for great design and intuitive UX

- 
Strong Computer Science fundamentals

- 
Extensive experience modern front end frameworks (e.g., Vue.js, React.js) and CSS-in-JS libraries (e.g., styled-components)

- 
Experience designing and building data heavy front-end applications

- 
Experience with virtual currencies, applications, and their use in financial networks and blockchain analysis is a plus

- 
Adaptable. Goals can change fast. You anticipate and react quickly.

- 
Autonomous. You own what you work on. You move fast and get things done.

- 
Excellent communication. You will need to communicate complex ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, and both verbally and in writing

- 
Collaborative. You must work collaboratively in a cross-functional team and with people at all levels in an organization

- 
US Citizenship required 

About the Team: 

- 
The team operates on a weekly sprint schedule. Individuals on the team are tasked to lead projects as technical anchors, and given a chance to grow and take ownership according to their level and goals. 

- 
We work closely with product, design, and with our engineering partners in data platform teams to deliver impactful features to customers and the company.

- 
The team’s timezone is a mix of EST and PST, with at least 6 hours of overlap with PST (8 am to 2 pm PST).

- 
On Call: We have an on-call rotation that is approximately one week every 16 weeks.

- 
Frontend usually doesn't get pager duty alerts but gets frontend issues from customer support channels and the on-call is responsible for triaging if it is a frontend bug or sometimes really a backend issue.

- 
It gets busy during some on-call weeks but has not been wake-up from sleep type of alerts.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

Ruthless Prioritization & Adaptability : We adapt quickly when faced with new information. - 
Challenging Timelines (Execution Pressure): An engineer questions a teammate’s proposed 3-week timeline, and constructively argues for condensing it to 2 weeks—backed by rationale, tradeoffs, and a plan to reduce scope or increase velocity. They show ownership of delivery speed and willingness to push for urgency.

- 
Time-Boxed Spiking (Rapid Learning & Decision-Making): An engineer proposes a 1-week spike with a clear time-box and success criteria to explore implementation options or validate feasibility through a proof of concept. They demonstrate speed not just in execution, but in de-risking decisions early.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: 

- 
Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

- 
The estimated base salary range for this role is $180,000-$230,000.

- 
Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

- 
Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

About TRM's Engineering Levels: 

Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing.

Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing.

Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor.

Work Week Travel: This role requires participation in in-person R&D work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter , at a TRM hub or other designated location. Work weeks may be scheduled with as little as 14 days’ notice , and some roles may require additional travel based on team and cross-functional needs. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace. Accommodations are available for legitimate caregiving, health, immigration, and similar constraints.

Application Instructions 

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

- 
Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

- 
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

- 
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

- 
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

- 
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

- 
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

- 
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM 

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

- 
Accelerate repeatable workflows

- 
Structure and solve problems

- 
Improve output quality

- 
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM 

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

- 
Priorities and targets to change quickly

- 
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

- 
A high level of personal ownership and accountability

- 
Close collaboration across teams and functions

- 
Frequent, high-touch communication

- 
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- 
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 

Leadership Principles 

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

- 
Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

- 
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

- 
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission 

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalogue consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

The CVP team owns the core platform and services that govern how content is geofenced, balanced, and surfaced across Vinted's growing international network of markets. We build robust systems and tooling that manage cross-border visibility, enabling smooth and gradual market connections (e.g., FR-DE, BE-FR-ES) while optimising key liquidity metrics like Sell-Through Rate (STR%) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) by balancing the content in multiple channels.

Our team works closely with Content Visibility Management, Search, and Recommender relevance teams to accelerate product development. Currently, we are driving the automation of content visibility experimentation & analysis. Rather than having different content channels independently re-implement visibility controls, we are building a unified platform to provide autonomy to Decision Scientists. In addition, we are highly contributing in growing new large markets such as the USA and Australia.

In this position, you’ll 

- Drive technical execution: Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems to ensure efficient content visibility and search mechanisms.

- Guide technical decisions: Contribute to and challenge the technical direction of our backend services, leading system design reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.

- Scale features globally: Implement and shape A/B tested features that positively impact our 80+ million users. Code changes are rolled out instantly to production.

- Own your services: Monitor and improve backend service performance and stability. The team owns and monitors service-layer measurements (SLIs, SLOs, etc.) and has an on-call rotation which you will participate in.

- Lead team-level initiatives: Lead and drive technical initiatives within the team, while collaborating on domain-wide integrations with other engineering teams (such as Search and Recommender relevance teams).

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with engineering and product managers, analysts, and other stakeholders, facilitating clear communication within the team and across domains.

- Contribute to product direction: Provide technical feasibility assessments, identify technical risks, and provide effort estimations to help shape our team's product roadmap.

- Foster engineering excellence: Mentor, guide, and share knowledge with other engineers in the team to support their technical growth and promote collaborative best practices

About you 

- You have extensive experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, distributed, and highly available systems.

- You are highly proficient in backend development. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.

- Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.

- A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.

title: Enterprise AI Consultant
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team 

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role 

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do 

Solution Architecture & Design 

- Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed

- Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies

- Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals

- Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.

- Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes

- Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation 

- Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates

- Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively

- Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical

- Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory 

- Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders

- Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics

- Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope

- Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change

- Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements

- Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation 

- Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers

- Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering

- Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth 

- Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

- Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development 

- Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments

- Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership

- Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer 

- Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)

- Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality

- Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered

- Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need 

- Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.) 

- Architecture skills: Proven ability to design complex, multi-component solutions that span data integration, process intelligence, automation, and AI, while remaining grounded in the “so-what” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.

- AI & agent orchestration: Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.

- Domain expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.

- Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.

- Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries via a working knowledge of Python.

- Consulting & communication: Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences. Experience leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.

- Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of teams around you. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.

- Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About the role 

Data science is in a moment of reinvention: AI-generated code and agentic workflows are changing what it means to put analytical work into production. Posit’s mission is to empower people to conduct trustworthy data analysis for themselves, their organizations, and the world at large. Posit Team is the trusted on-premises platform at the center: a place where data scientists and the organizations that rely on them can explore data, deploy applications and agents, expose and consume MCP servers, and do all of it with the visibility, accountability, and reproducibility that serious analytical work demands. 

We are seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bring a builder’s instinct to a team working at the intersection of data science, infrastructure, and AI. You will help us build new capabilities and features in our product suite, including things we haven’t yet imagined possible, and you will drive those changes forward into our customers’ hands.

About you 

You are an enthusiastic generalist who thrives in the face of ambiguous requirements—an engineer who is just as good at starting things as you are at finishing them. Some qualities we value most:

High agency 

You are driven. When something important feels daunting or underspecified, your first instinct is to prototype to clarify the value you can deliver, rather than wait for someone to give you the answers.

Boldness in learning 

You are genuinely unafraid to tackle unfamiliar subjects. You know that nobody is an expert in everything, and you don't let unfamiliarity be a reason for not trying. You're not afraid to ask questions and make mistakes, because learning new techniques feels like an adventure and we share what we learn as a team. Proficiency in either Go or Typescript as well as in either Python or R, and experience with backend systems, data tooling, and data science frameworks are helpful for this role. Eagerness and boldness to learn is essential. 

User empathy and product sense 

You make judgment calls on behalf of users with minimal up front guidance and are willing to be wrong, because you will learn. Prior domain expertise with data science as a practice may help, but it is not the only way. Regardless, you lead with empathy: you optimize for solving a real customer problem, not for technical purity.

Collaborative curiosity 

You are generous. When you learn something useful, your first instinct is to share it. You teach as readily as you learn, ask questions without ego, admit what you don't know, and lend a hand when someone's stuck.

Interest in AI 

You are interested not just in using AI in your work, but building tools for customers to use AI in their own work. You also are curious, and you question when AI is not the right answer for a particular problem. You lean on your user empathy when building: knowing that some of our customers use and love AI in data science and others don’t or are restricted from using it.

Results-driven 

You are focused on delivering measurable value to customers. You have a strong technical background with a track record of shipping successful products. 

Within one week, you will… 

- Ship code changes that meaningfully improves the experience for our customers.

Within one month, you will… 

- See your changes reflected in our public releases.

- Participate in feature planning and provide feedback.

- Feel comfortable navigating the codebase and understand how things fit together.

Within three months, you will… 

- Plan features and drive their development.

- Have a track record of teaching team members; both from your expertise and things you learn as you build. 

- Have a track record of learning: both from the things you learned and taught us along the way; and from listening to internal users, external users, and how our customers use our products.

Within six months, you will… 

- Point to new features you built that we hadn’t even dreamed were possible.

Posit offers competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This hiring range reflects base salary and assumes that the job will be performed in the United States.

Hiring Range

$141,800—$187,110 USD

Working at Posit:

- We welcome all talented colleagues and are committed to a culture that represents diversity in all its forms .

- We prioritize giving ourselves “focus time” to get deep work done. We minimize meetings and attempt to operate asynchronously.

- We are a learning organization and take mentorship and career growth seriously. We hope to learn from you and we anticipate that you will also deepen your skills, influence, and leadership as a result of working at Posit.

- We operate under a unique sustainable business model : We have over 50% of our engineering dedicated to creating free and open source software. We are profitable and we plan to be around decades from now.

- Posit is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and a Certified B Corporation®, which means our open-source mission is codified into our charter. As a result, our corporate decisions balance the community's interests, customers, employees, and shareholders. Hear more about why we think this matters here .

We offer competitive compensation with extensive human-first, people-focused benefits to prioritize your personal and financial well-being. These benefits apply to full-time positions only.

Are you excited about this role but not sure if your experience aligns with every qualification in the job description? That’s okay. We know multiple perspectives are essential for a thriving organization and we'd still love to hear from you!

title: Working Student - Data Science (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions 

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second , we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake , providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference . We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines , and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second .

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For 

- Quantitative Academic Foundation: You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. You are available to contribute up to 20 hours per week during the semester.

- ML Model Prototyping: You will support the research and evaluation of deep learning and machine learning models that predict user behavior across our 770 million user base. We are looking for solid Python skills and hands-on familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and gradient boosting libraries (LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost) to prototype new algorithms.

- Large-Scale Data Exploration: Operating on our 1PB+ behavioral data lake, you will extract patterns from terabytes of data to engineer high-fidelity features for our training pipelines. This requires strong SQL fundamentals, an interest in distributed query engines (AWS Athena, Trino, Spark), and fluency with pandas, polars, and NumPy.

- Experimentation & Validation: You will collaborate closely with our data scientists to test your fit-for-purpose solutions against our multi-objective optimization problem. We need someone who can rigorously evaluate models through offline experiments and A/B tests before they hit our 100,000+ predictions-per-second production environment.

- Plus: ML Infrastructure Exposure: Any prior exposure to the systems that run our real-time scale—AWS, workflow orchestration (Airflow), containerization (Docker), or basic model deployment workflows—will accelerate your impact.

What’s in It for You? 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

- Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

- Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

- Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the Role

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will take responsibility for our most complex data platform work, owning the ingestion pipelines, streaming infrastructure and platform capabilities that Analytics Engineering, Data Science and business teams rely on every day. Based in our London HQ, you will support the Hims US business as part of the wider Hims & Hers data community, working closely with data teams on both sides of the Atlantic.

Working across data engineering, platform engineering and analytics, you will act as the directly responsible owner for multi-sprint initiatives, including CDC connector buildouts, our BigQuery warehouse workstreams and event-streaming infrastructure. You will also mentor Senior Data Engineers, helping them grow from squad-level to cross-squad impact, and help raise the engineering standards of the whole team as we scale our preventative care ecosystem globally.

What You’ll Do

- Guide Platform Initiatives: Take ownership of high-complexity, multi-sprint initiatives, including CDC connector buildouts, BigQuery warehouse workstreams, event-streaming infrastructure, lower environments and adoption of shared standards.

- Build Dependable Ingestion: Design and maintain ingestion pipelines and platform infrastructure, from source connectivity through the raw and cleansed warehouse layers, that Analytics Engineering, Data Science and business teams rely on daily. Take responsibility for production deployments of containerised services on Kubernetes (EKS) across our AWS and GCP environments.

- Run Streaming Pipelines: Design and look after event-driven and streaming pipelines using Kafka (AWS MSK) and Flink on EKS, delivering CDC and user event tracking (UET) streams into BigQuery, with scaling approaches, cost guardrails, consumer lag alerting and runbooks in place before production rollout.

- Own CDC Ingestion: Take responsibility for change-data-capture pipelines from source systems into BigQuery end to end, from Terraform provisioning through schema change governance and production monitoring.

- Own Data Contracts: Take responsibility for raw-to-cleansed data contracts, schema governance and SLAs, agreeing expectations with the teams who depend on them.

- Champion Data Quality: Ship pipelines with built-in quality checks, including dbt tests, anomaly detection, schema validation and data-drift alerting, so our data stays trustworthy.

- Strengthen System Reliability: Agree KPIs and SLOs, build monitoring and alerting as code with Datadog (or equivalent), join the on-call rotation, and look after Tier 1 tickets and runbooks across your area, working through the root causes rather than the symptoms.

- Empower Data Teams: Build platform capabilities that unblock Analytics Engineering, Data Science and ML roadmaps. Partner with legal, security and DevOps on compliance controls, including HIPAA/PHI handling, UK GDPR and cross-border access to patient data, and on IaC hardening.

- Mentor & Share Standards: Mentor Senior Data Engineers through design reviews, code reviews and pairing, helping them grow their impact to cross-squad scope. Help the team adopt good practice in testing, CI/CD, observability as code, Airflow, dbt and Schema Registry governance, and join ARC reviews for changes with cross-team or financial impact.

About You 

- Platform Engineering Depth: You are a highly experienced data engineer (typically 8+ years) who has designed, built and run production ingestion and streaming platforms at scale. You are confident in Python and SQL, comfortable with Kafka, Flink, dbt, Airflow and BigQuery, and ideally have built Kafka-ecosystem services in Kotlin, Go or similar.

- Initiative Ownership: You have taken ownership of complex, multi-sprint technical initiatives as the directly responsible owner, from scoping and design docs through to production rollout, and can keep several teams aligned along the way.

- Reliability Mindset: You treat reliability as part of the design. You have set SLOs, built monitoring and alerting as code, worked on-call rotations and written the runbooks that make operations repeatable.

- Data Quality & Governance: You build quality checks into pipelines from the start, and you have experience with data contracts, schema governance and tooling such as a Schema Registry.

- Infrastructure as Code: You are comfortable with Terraform and CI/CD patterns across AWS and GCP, and enjoy working alongside DevOps and security colleagues to harden them.

- Mentoring & Influence: You help other engineers grow through design reviews, code reviews and pairing. You work across squads, take part in architecture reviews and share standards that other teams choose to adopt.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work well with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, legal and security, and can explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues.

Nice to have 

- Experience in regulated sectors (such as healthtech, fintech or gaming), finding creative paths forward inside compliance constraints rather than being stopped by them. Familiarity with reverse-ETL / data activation tools such as Hightouch or Segment is also a plus.

Why join Eucalyptus

- What's next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer, launching into new conditions, demographics and geographies.

- Build something world-changing - We're on the path to becoming the world's largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced and deeply rewarding.

- Make real impact - Your work directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

- Accelerate your growth - High ownership, continuous feedback and dedicated development support.

- Join a motivated team - Talented peers solving complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What's ahead in the UK

- Be an owner - Your own stake in the business with our employee options programme

- Invest in your growth - Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave

- Work flexibly - Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration

- Support your well-being - Private health insurance through Vitality, or a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you

- Take time off - 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks a year

- Join a connected team - A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport and seasonal events

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

title: Sr DataOps Engineer (R14334)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - MX

Who We Are 

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. 

The Opportunity 

We’re looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to help operate, scale, and improve the data platforms that support Oportun’s analytics, engineering, and business teams. This role will focus on Databricks, AWS, data pipelines, databases, observability, automation, and production support. 

You’ll be responsible for keeping critical data-platform services reliable, secure, performant, and cost-effective while partnering closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Security, Cloud Infrastructure, Database, and application teams. Success in this role means improving platform reliability, reducing operational friction, strengthening automation, and helping teams resolve issues quickly and sustainably. 

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. 

What You'll Do 

Your day-to-day 

- You’ll administer and support Databricks workspaces, cluster policies, compute configurations, jobs, workflows, libraries, service principals, permissions, and platform integrations. 

- You’ll support Unity Catalog, including access governance, catalog and schema permissions, and secure data sharing. 

- You’ll monitor and troubleshoot Delta Live Tables, Spark jobs, Delta Lake workloads, and data pipelines, including failures, performance issues, recovery, and data-quality concerns. 

- You’ll maintain secure and reliable integrations between Databricks and AWS services, including S3, IAM, networking, VPC connectivity, and external data sources. 

- You’ll support AWS infrastructure used by the data platform, including EC2, VPC, IAM, security groups, networking, patching, and operational access. 

- You’ll support MariaDB/MySQL and MongoDB environments, including availability, monitoring, connectivity, backup coordination, performance troubleshooting, and recovery. 

- You’ll build and maintain monitoring, dashboards, logs, metrics, and alerts across Databricks, pipelines, databases, infrastructure, and integrations.

- Expert-level programming skills in Python and Go, with an emphasis on writing production-quality, well-tested, and modular code.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. OUR VALUES

title: Senior AI Developer, Data
description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

At Workleap, turning AI experiments into production capabilities is already part of how we build products and improve internal operations. Our Data team brings strong data engineering and science foundations; this role adds dedicated production AI engineering. As a Senior AI Developer, you'll design, build, and operate the AI systems and agentic workflows that connect foundation models to our data, tools, and applications, and you'll set the technical direction for how we do it well.

Your impact: 

- Ship production AI systems and agentic workflows that deliver measurable value in Workleap's products and internal operations.

- Own the production quality of those systems: observability, testing, security, and cost built in from the start.

- Turn evaluation evidence from Data Scientists into engineering improvements, so we know whether a system is getting better or worse.

- Engineer the context integrations that let agents use governed data and application capabilities accurately.

- Define reusable patterns and components so the next team starts from a working foundation, not a blank page.

- Drive architecture decisions across quality, risk, and cost, and make the trade-offs explicit.

Your team

You'll join Workleap's Shared Tech - Data team , a hands-on team of six Data Engineers and Data Scientists responsible for the data and AI foundations supporting our products and internal teams. We value technical judgment, pragmatism, simplicity, autonomy, collaboration, and reliable delivery . You'll work closely with both disciplines and partner with Software Engineers, Product teams, and Platform and Security specialists to bring AI capabilities into production.

Over the next 6-12 months, you'll work on questions like: how does someone ask an analytical question of governed data and get an answer they can trust? How do we know an AI agent is good enough to take on more responsibility? How do we run AI features with the same rigor as any other critical system?

Our technology ecosystem includes Python, SQL, Snowflake (Cortex, Cortex Agents, Cortex Code), Claude, OpenAI, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry, Terraform, and GitHub .

What you'll bring

- Strong production engineering in Python and SQL, with testing, CI/CD, and experience operating cloud systems;

- Hands-on experience building and operating AI applications with foundation models, agents, tools, and context;

- Experience instrumenting and evaluating non-deterministic systems: observability, evals, regression testing;

- Sound architectural judgment across reliability, security, and cost, and the confidence to form and defend a technical opinion;

- Experience building components or tooling that other developers adopt;

- Working knowledge of Snowflake and its AI capabilities (Cortex), or the ability to ramp up on them quickly;

- A builder mindset: you own what you ship, experiment quickly, and use AI-assisted development tools daily and critically;

- Bonus: AI services on Azure, AWS, or GCP, or developer platforms that accelerate AI adoption across teams.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

- Base salary: $140 000 - $170 000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.

- Annual bonus program.

- LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.

- RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.

- Flexible vacation policy.

- Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.

- In-person gatherings twice a year.

- Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us 

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire 

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy .

title: Operations Engineer, BizTech
description:
Headquarters: Remote- USA

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join: 

BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience. 

The Difference You Will Make: 

As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality. 

A Typical Day: 

- Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect

- Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time

- Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge

- Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead

- Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows

- Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution

Your Expertise: 

- 3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch)

- 3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS)

- Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto)

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code

- Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud

- Comfort working in ticket/workflow-driven environments using Jira and Confluence

- Experience supporting enterprise SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, Workday) and SSO/identity integration (e.g., Okta) is a plus

Your Location 

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. 

Equal Employment Opportunity: 

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You: 

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 

Pay Range

$136,000 — $160,000 USD 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-operations-engineer-biztech

title: Ingénieur SRE senior (H/F)
description:

En tant qu’ingénieur·e SRE senior, vous portez des projets structurants de bout en bout et vous entraînez l’équipe avec vous . Dans une petite équipe où chacun touche à beaucoup de sujets, nous recherchons un profil polyvalent plutôt qu’un expert d’un seul outil.

Profil et compétences

- Vous avez une culture de l’observabilité et de la gestion d’incidents (post-mortems, SLO/SLI) 

- Vous avez la capacité à développer de l’outillage en Go, Python ou Bash 

- Vous avez l’esprit de partage et vous êtes pédagogue 

- Vous parlez l’anglais 

Les plus qui feront la différence 

- Vous avez une expérience d’un cloud souverain 

- Vous connaissez le monde de la supervision IT et de l’open source 

- L’IA n’a plus de secret pour vous, vous l’utilisez au service de l’exploitation 

Ce que nous offrons

title: Consultant Digital Analytics & SEO (80 - 100%)
description:
Daten im Kopf? SEO im Blut? Dann suchen wir genau dich! Wir bieten dir die passende Stelle als Digital Analytics & SEO Consultant (w/m/x) bei Digital Leverage in Zürich. Der Starttermin ist flexibel. 

Wir sind Digital Leverage, eine erfahrene SEO- & GEO-Agentur mit Sitz in Zürich und grossen Plänen. Unsere Kund:innen sind vielfältig und dynamisch – B2B, B2C, vom agilen KMU bis zum etablierten Grossunternehmen. So bekommst du spannende Einblicke in verschiedene Branchen und Unternehmen.

Unsere Kundschaft will verstehen, was digitale Sichtbarkeit – von der klassischen Suche bis zu KI-Antworten – bewirkt. Dafür brauchen wir verlässliche Daten, durchdachte Messkonzepte und Menschen, die daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Aufgaben

Als Digital Analytics & SEO Consultant arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen SEO/GEO und KPI-Tracking und -Reporting. In deinen Projekten übernimmst du vom ersten Moment an das Ruder. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen, entwickelst passende Messkonzepte und Dashboards und begleitest deren Umsetzung. Du hilfst ihnen, die Wirkung ihrer digitalen Aktivitäten zu verstehen und ihre Sichtbarkeit in Suchmaschinen und KI-Antworten gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Team an SEO-, GEO- und Content-Spezialist:innen sowie den Marketing- und Entwicklungsteams unserer Kund:innen zusammen. Du bekommst viel Freiraum, Verantwortung und die Gelegenheit, unser Angebot im Bereich Digital Analytics aktiv mitzugestalten.

Die interne Weiterentwicklung zur/zum Lead Digital Analytics wird begrüsst und gefördert! 

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören u.a.: 

- Entwicklung von Messkonzepten, KPI-Frameworks und Tracking-Plänen entlang der Customer Journey

- Einrichtung und Weiterentwicklung von Tracking-Lösungen mit Google Analytics 4 und Google Tag Manager unter Berücksichtigung der Consent-Anforderungen

- Durchführung von Analytics- und Tracking-Audits sowie Qualitätssicherung und Verbesserung der Datenqualität

- Aufbau und Betreuung von Prompt-Trackings zur Messung der Sichtbarkeit unserer Kund:innen in KI-Antworten, beispielsweise mit Peec AI oder Rankscale

- Begleitung von Relaunch-Projekten aus Analytics- und Tracking-Perspektive

- Analyse von Traffic, Nutzerverhalten und Conversions sowie Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmöglichkeiten

- Analyse der KI-Sichtbarkeit, Markennennungen und Quellenverweise im Wettbewerbsvergleich sowie Einordnung des messbaren Traffics aus KI-Plattformen

- Erstellung und Interpretation verständlicher Dashboards (bspw. Data Studio, Adobe Analytics etc.) und Reportings, die Ergebnisse und Handlungsmöglichkeiten auf den Punkt bringen

- Eigenständige Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kund:innen sowie Entwicklung datenbasierter Empfehlungen für ihre GEO-Strategie

- Coaching von Teammitgliedern und externen Ansprechpartnern

Qualifikation

Wir sind grosse Fans von Menschen mit Drive und Eigeninitiative. Du hast bereits einiges an Erfahrung in den Bereichen Digital Analytics, SEO und GEO gesammelt und Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen, Daten kritisch zu hinterfragen und Erkenntnisse verständlich zu vermitteln.

Du verbindest analytisches Denken mit einem guten Gespür für die Ziele unserer Kundschaft. Dabei fühlst du dich im Austausch mit externen Marketingverantwortlichen ebenso wohl wie in der Zusammenarbeit mit deinem Team. Du brennst für Daten und möchtest mitgestalten, wie Unternehmen ihre Sichtbarkeit und deren Wirkung in einer sich verändernden Suchlandschaft messen.

Dein Profil: 

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Digital Analytics, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder beratenden Funktion

- Erfahrung und starkes Interesse für die Bereiche SEO und GEO

- Sicherer Umgang mit Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Data Studio – Erfahrung mit Adobe Analytics und Matomo ist von Vorteil

- Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Messkonzepten sowie in der Umsetzung und Qualitätssicherung von Event- und Conversion-Tracking

- Gutes Verständnis für Datenqualität, Consent Management und die Grenzen digitaler Erfolgsmessung

- Fähigkeit, aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten und diese überzeugend zu präsentieren

- Grundlegende Kenntnisse in HTML und JavaScript sowie Verständnis für Data Layers und die technische Funktionsweise von Websites

- Freude an Kundenberatung, Projektleitung und der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse, mündlich und schriftlich

- Strukturierte, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise – auch wenn mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig laufen

Benefits

Du profitierst von: 

- Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege: Bei uns gibt es keine "Chefetage".

- Grünes Büro direkt im Kreis 4: Profitiere von einem top ausgestatteten Büro, vielseitigen Lunch-Möglichkeiten und super Verbindungen zum HB.

- Selbstbestimmtes Arbeiten: Tageweise Homeoffice, Gleitzeiten oder auch mal Remote Work aus dem Ausland – du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsplatz!

- Aktive Weiterbildung: Deine Weiterentwicklung wird geschätzt und gefördert – Ehrenwort.

- Attraktive Fringe Benefits: 13. Monatslohn plus Bonus, Pauschalspesen, langfristige Möglichkeit Firmenanteile zu erwerben und mehr!

- Moderne Kultur: Bist du ready für offenen Feedbackaustausch, monatliche Teamevents, jährliche Workation in Europa und Lohntransparenz?
