title: Founding Data Researcher
description:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Researcher to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis 

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role 

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on 

- Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

- Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

- Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

- Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

- Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

- Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For 

- You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

- Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

- Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

- Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have 

- Computer vision and document understanding , images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

- Graph and structured scientific data , molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

- Synthetic worlds and simulation , a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

- Foundation models from scratch , real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

- Public evidence of data ownership , lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

- GIS and geometry , parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

- Multi-country data , heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis 

- Own the data end to end , from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

- Shape a foundation model from scratch , on a structured representation no one else is training on.

- Work on genuinely hard problems , image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity , at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

- Join a world-class team , a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after: 

Team 

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win 

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work , AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design 

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability , and parametric tools only check constraints after generation , which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this , but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. 

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer (R14153)
description:

Who We Are

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. 

What You'll Do 

Your day-to-day 

- You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. 

- You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. 

- You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security.

- You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. 

- You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. 

- You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. 

Who You Are 

The right fit looks like this 

You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. 

You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. 

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

Required 

- 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. 

- Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. 

- Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. 

- Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. 

- Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. 

- Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies.

- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. 

- Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. 

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. 

- Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. 

Nice to Have 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

- Databricks experience or certification.

- Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services.

- Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks.

- Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives.

- Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity.

Our AI Mindset 

We build with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

title: CAD scripting Expert
description:
Headquarters: 

Overview

We are building evaluation benchmarks that test whether AI agents can complete real professional work from start to finish. We are hiring expert mechanical design and CAD automation engineers to turn real, paid CAD tasks from their own work into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the files and systems it runs on, a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

• Build automated checks and tests that prove the result is objectively correct, covering geometry, dimensions, tolerances and file outputs such as STEP or IGES.

• Calibrate difficulty so each task takes an expert about 60-75 minutes to solve, and explain how a real-world mistake would be caught by the checks.

Nice-to-have

• Parametric design-intent experience

• Open-source hardware contributions or projects

• Docker and Git experience

• Experience writing automated tests

• Experience with SolidWorks, Fusion or Onshape APIs and STEP/IGES workflows

Process

title: Senior Platform Engineer - Developer Experience
description:
Senior Platform Engineer - Developer Experience 

Hybrid in London or Remote within the United Kingdom

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Platform team. 

You’ll enable everyone at iwoca to build and ship with confidence, from engineers to analysts. You'll make it simpler and safer for people to deploy apps on their own, and keep improving the experience as iwoca grows.

The company 

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team 

The Platform team leads iwoca’s developer experience work. It looks after three areas:

- Infrastructure. iwoca’s Kubernetes platform, GitOps deployments, CI components, and developer environments.

- The route to production. The templates, tooling, and safe defaults teams use to go from a repository to production and run their own services.

- The AI platform. Access to the latest models, an internal Claude Code plugin marketplace, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI tools to iwoca’s systems.

The Platform team is part of Core Systems, a group of about a dozen people who provide the shared tools and infrastructure that iwoca’s engineering, data, and analytics teams rely on. You’ll be one of six engineers in the Platform team.

The role 

As the Senior Platform Engineer, you’ll own the developer experience roadmap and agree with the team on where you can make the biggest impact for the platform’s users. You’ll decide how each self-service tool works and build it yourself, making clear trade-offs between developer experience, reliability, security, and cost. The tools you build help teams get code live faster which results in fewer support requests for the Platform team.

Today, getting a new service live takes many separate steps and a lot of platform knowledge. You’ll spend most of your time building new self-service tools, and the rest migrating existing tooling and talking to users about where they get stuck. If you haven’t worked deeply with Kubernetes, Terraform, or GitOps, you can learn them here, with the team and plenty of resources to help. You’ll likely start with the friction map below.

Live project examples:

- Friction map. Measuring how long it takes someone outside Core Systems to get new code live, and how many steps they go through. The result could be written documentation or a dashboard.

- New services. Turning the merge requests a new service needs into one guided flow, so fewer changes wait for review.

- AI guardrails. Building the Claude skills and checks that help AI-written changes pass review and deploy cleanly first time.

The requirements 

Essential:

- Software engineering. You’ve written and maintained production code in Python or Go, including tools and automation.

- Ownership. You’ve set the direction for a platform or tooling area and looked after it for the long term. You’ve decided what to fix first and seen the work through.

- Building for internal users. You’ve built tooling and written documentation for other engineers, or for colleagues who aren’t engineers, and changed both based on how people used them.

- AI leverage. You’ve used AI to produce work you couldn’t have delivered without it. You know where it speeds up changes, and where a change needs careful human review.

Bonus:

- Kubernetes. You’ve deployed and debugged services on Kubernetes, and know its common resources and terms.

- CI/CD and GitOps. You’ve built or maintained CI pipelines in GitLab CI or a similar system, and deployed services through a GitOps tool such as Flux or Argo CD.

- Infrastructure as code. You’ve defined cloud resources in Terraform or a similar tool.

- Delivery metrics. You’ve tracked measures such as lead time or deployment frequency, and used them to judge whether a change helped.

- Developer environments. You’ve worked with cloud workspaces or devcontainers, and know what makes a developer environment pleasant to work in.

The salary 

We expect to pay from £90,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture 

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices 

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits 

- Flexible working hours.

- Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

- A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

- 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

- A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

- Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

- 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

- An employee equity incentive scheme.

- Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

- Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

- Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone.

- Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

- Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

- We’re shaping our next generation infrastructure that is hardened from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity - no legacy tech or off-the-shelf product solutions. There is a lot to do around this new development as well as our “classic” platforms of the three companies.

- The greater team is not just information security - we’re more holistic, and also physical security and safety are a part of our global operations.

This position is open in our Wolt hubs in Berlin, Germany , or Helsinki, Finland , and will be a part of the Global Security Engineering team.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale.

- Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, Security teams and Vendor Partners to build “paved paths” that provide actionable feedback to embed secure design practices into the product and infrastructure development process.

- Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.

Over time, your role can evolve depending on your interests and skills. Our company is a large place and there’s a lot to do!

As the Security team sometimes needs to address high-priority security issues as well as ensure the availability of the components we have built, this position includes an on-call duty. On-call compensation and terms will be agreed separately in accordance with the local employment law.

Our humble expectations*

Health can’t wait .

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

title: Data Platform Engineer

Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt , Airflow , S3 , AWS , Superset , and GitHub Actions . We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help evolve the DWH platform, push its technical boundaries, and deliver reliable, high-performance data models to business users across the organization.

- Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.

- Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.

- Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.

- Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.

Qualifications 

Required: 

- Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.

- Strong hands-on experience with Airflow , dbt , and Python .

- Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.

- Solid understanding of data warehousing fundamentals: ETL/ELT, dimensional modeling, and data quality.

Preferred:

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

title: Organic Discovery, Growth Engineer
description:
TL;DR: 
How people discover Lovable is being rebuilt in real time. They now find software through Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and others, and nobody has the full playbook yet. We're looking for an SEO and AEO specialist who wants to write it for Lovable and turn that visibility into subscribers and revenue. You're technical enough to land your own code and agentic enough to build the tools you need with AI. One sprint you're fixing how lovable.dev gets crawled and rendered; the next you're shipping pages for our highest-intent searches, or an agent that tracks where Lovable shows up in AI answers. Your first instinct is always: will people and answer engines find this, and does it help us grow?

Why Lovable? 

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

The role 

You'll own organic discoverability for Lovable. Answer engines come first, on top of a strong foundation in traditional search. You do the strategy, building and measurement, there's no queue between an insight and a live change.

You'll build most of your tools, pages and agents on Lovable itself, and take what you learn straight to the product team. Millions of apps are published on Lovable and each one needs to be found too, so what works for lovable.dev should become better defaults and guides for our users.

What we’re looking for 

- 5+ years in SEO, AEO or organic growth on a user-facing web product at scale. Results you've driven count for more than years.

- Hands-on AEO. You've tracked how AI assistants mention and cite a brand, tested what moves it, and can show the results.

- Deep technical SEO. Rendering, crawling, indexing, structured data, sitemaps, canonicals and internal linking at scale. When something breaks, you find out why.

- Agentic by default. You use AI coding tools and LLM APIs to build agents, scripts and internal tools that automate audits, monitoring and reporting, without waiting on engineering.

- You land code. You know enough web fundamentals (HTML, JavaScript, React, APIs) to work in our codebase, get changes through review into production, and own them after launch. You don't need to be a senior software engineer.

- Strong with data. SQL, Search Console, log files, event tracking, and tests that tell you something real.

- Good content and product judgment. You know what makes a page worth citing and cut what isn't working.

- Motivated by the scoreboard: traffic, citations, subscribers, revenue.

What you’ll do 

In one sentence: you'll own how Lovable gets found across search engines and AI assistants, and build the site, systems and tools that turn that into growth.

- Set the organic roadmap. Decide where Lovable needs to show up across Google, AI Overviews and AI assistants, which topics and queries matter most, and what we leave alone.

- Own the technical health of lovable.dev . Rendering, crawling, indexing, site structure, internal links, structured data and speed are yours. Keep search traffic safe through relaunches and redesigns.

- Ship pages that win high-intent search. Use search demand, prompt data and competitor gaps to pick what to build and refresh, then ship hub pages, templates, comparisons and other page systems. Work with content and product marketing on what goes on them.

- Get Lovable cited beyond our own site. Find the forums, communities, publications and docs that AI answers lean on for our category, and work with community, PR and partnerships to earn a place there.

- Make experimentation cheap and fast. Build the setup that lets the team test page formats, technical changes and distribution ideas in days, keep a record of each test, and double down on what works.

- Build the tools search runs on. Replace manual audits, monitoring and reporting with automations and agents, ideally built on Lovable, with a person checking the work where accuracy matters.

- Own how we measure organic. Tie rankings, AI citations and organic traffic to subscribers and revenue in the warehouse, so we can invest in organic with the same confidence as paid. Say plainly where the data has gaps.

- Help Lovable apps get found. Work with product engineering on SEO and AEO defaults (metadata, social previews, sitemaps, rendering) for the apps our users publish, and share what works as guides.

- Share what you learn. Bring findings back to product, and share our results with users and the wider community.

- Keep it Lovable. Search should make the site better for people, never worse.

Our tech stack 

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

- Frontend: React

- Backend: Golang and Rust

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers

- DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

About your application 

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

- Physical/embedded device security. 

- OT (operational technology) network security. 

- OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

- Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines. 

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments.

You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

- Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

- Security architecture review process 

- Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation

- You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

- You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

- You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

- You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

- You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

- You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence
description:
Headquarters: New Jersey, USA

URL: https://vertican.com 

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required 

- 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.

- Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.

- Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.

- Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.

- You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.

- Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.

- Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.

- Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have 

- Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.

- Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.

- Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.

- Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.

- Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

- A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software

- Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.

- Monthly payments in USD

Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vertican-senior-applied-ai-engineer-document-intelligence

That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.

As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations, you will: 

- Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.

- Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions. Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure. 

- Build Defensible Documentation: Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.

- Collaborate Across Functions: Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.

- Communicate Findings Clearly: Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.

Success in this role looks like: 

- In your first 90 days , you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.

- By 6 months , you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.

- By 12 months , you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.

You should get in touch if: 

- Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes & investigative experience: You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care. You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.

- You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs: You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work. 

- Strong communication skills: You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Bonus points if: 

- 

- You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide.

- You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance.

- You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan.

- You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC.

Benefits Overview :

Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.

title: Senior Product Data Scientist
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Analytics organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across product, commercial and operations through experimentation and causal inference.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you'll enable high-quality human-led decision-making to maximise impact.

We're hiring multiple Senior Data Scientists across different areas of the business. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope, remit and team.

About Our Analytics Organisation 

We have an outstanding analytics organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making.

Our community is highly active, with guest lectures, study groups, mentorship programmes and a robust technical review process. Data Scientists can progress equally as technical leads or people managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not.

What You'll Be Doing 

You will help answer questions like:

- 
Which markets/cities should we enter next?

- 
How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?

- 
What is the impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants?

- 
How do we optimise our compensation policy to keep our customers happy and ordering with Deliveroo?

- 
What are the trade-offs we face when choosing between growth and profitability? How should we decide between them?

- 
How much should our pricing vary by distance and by market?

- 
What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants in a particular area?

- 
How do we adapt our consumer app to better suit grocery shoppers?

What You'll Need to Thrive 

- 
Significant experience in Data Science (or similar) roles.

- 
Experience leading both simple and more complex experiment designs, with the ability to proactively unpick insights to steer strategic decision making

- 
Great communication skills - in person, in writing, in code; to technical and non-technical audiences.

- 
Through solid analysis, provide clear and actionable recommendations that influence the team's roadmap.

- 
Effective problem-solving, demonstrating an ability to successfully address complex and ambiguous challenges.

- 
Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

- 
Proficiency with analytical tools like R/Python and familiarity with SQL. Proficiency with Cursor/AI tools to deliver impactful, high-quality work efficiently is also valued

- 
A pragmatic, flexible approach, where you most care about achieving impact

- 
Excellent people skills — you'll be meeting with a range of both technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate business needs into data science problems

Why Join Us? 

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here .

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place. 

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel. 

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary 

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day. 

- Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

- Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

- Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

- Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

- Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

- Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

- Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

- Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

- Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

- Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack 

What we're hoping you'll bring with you. 

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker).

✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data.

✅ A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you're happy to set the strategy and get your hands dirty, and you enjoy the hygiene work others tend to avoid.

✅ Excellent communication skills: you can explain trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike.

Bonus points if you have: 

✨ Experience with mobile attribution or marketing data (e.g. AppsFlyer, SKAdNetwork, ad platform APIs).

✨ Experience with reverse ETL or CDPs (e.g. RudderStack, Twilio Segment).

✨ Experience with experimentation data and A/B testing infrastructure.

✨ Knowledge of GDPR and handling personal data responsibly in an analytics stack.

1st class Polarsteps extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet. 

- A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here. 

- A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

- Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

- An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

- 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you). 

- Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

- The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

- A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

- A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

- Delicious daily team lunches.

- Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

- A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

- Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

title: AI Developer
description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it.

Role Overview We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. title: Senior Applications Engineer (West Coast)
description:
About Standard Bots 

Standard Bots is building the next generation of industrial robots -- hardware that's powerful, affordable, and designed to scale. We're the largest U.S. industrial robotics company by robots shipped, and our robots are showing up on factory floors everywhere from independent machine shops to NASA and Lockheed Martin. 

Note: This role is technically remote, but you must live on the west coast (preference for California). This job is customer-facing and requires up to 50% domestic travel, Monday through Friday. If that makes you nervous, this probably isn't the right fit. If that sounds like a perk, read on. 

Also note: This is not a software engineering role. If you're looking for a job where you sit at a desk and write application code, this is the wrong job description. If you want to actually build things, wire things up, and watch them run -- keep reading. 

The Role 

The Senior Applications Engineer is one of the rarest profiles in industrial automation -- and one of the most important roles at Standard Bots.

You're not a mechanical engineer. You're not an electrical engineer. You're not a software engineer. You're all three, and you know how to make them talk to each other. You can look at a customer's production line, understand what's broken or slow or manual, and figure out how to fix it with a robot. Then you build the proof of concept, get on a plane, and go install it.

From pre to post sale, you're the one working closely with the sales team to make the solution real. You'll build the proof of concept, design the integration, write the python scripts, build the fixture, run the wiring, and commission the cell -- then train the customer's team on how to use it. You'll also help run demos at trade shows, support trainings at customer sites and in our shop, and be the technical backbone for every customer engagement that requires hands-on expertise.

This is a builder's role. Tinkerers welcome. People who get bored at a desk are strongly encouraged to apply.

What You'll Do 

Solution Design & Proof of Concept 

- Work with the sales team and customers to understand automation goals, production constraints, and integration requirements

- Design practical, buildable solutions around Standard Bots' hardware -- and build the proof of concept yourself to validate it works before anyone signs anything

- Develop application notes, sample code, and supporting documentation that help customers and internal teams understand how to replicate and scale solutions

Field Installation & Integration 

- Travel to customer sites to install, program, wire, and commission robotic cells

- Own the integration from mechanical setup through software configuration -- fixtures, I/O, PLC handshakes, safety, test, sign-off

- Troubleshoot on-site when things don't go as planned (and sometimes they don't) -- you stay until it works

Customer Training & Support 

- Train customer operators and technicians on Standard Bots hardware and software -- both on-site and at our facility

- Support customers post-install as they find new applications and push the limits of what the robot can do

title: Software Development Engineer in Test II, NavNative
description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do 

The Navigation Native team builds the high-performance C++ engine that serves as the "brain" of our Navigation SDKs. This library runs directly on end-user systems (on-board), powering everything from mobile apps to in-vehicle infotainment systems for partners like BMW, Porsche, and Zeekr.

We solve the fundamental challenges of movement: transforming noisy GPS/IMU data into precise map-matching, managing complex road-network graphs, supporting routes and alternatives, tracking progress along a route, and providing "Electronic Horizon" capabilities for ADAS. Our work happens at the edge, supporting location frequencies up to 10Hz and ensuring a seamless experience even in tunnels or dense urban canyons.

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You'll Do 

We are looking for smart, fast-learning engineers who care as much about proving that navigation works as about making it work. As an SDE(T), you will:

- Build and maintain the unit, integration, and functional test architecture for a C++17 library, and the CMake and CI pipelines that run it.

- Turn real-world location recordings into regression tests, and define the quality metrics for map-matching, routing, and route-following.

- Keep the quality signal fast and trustworthy: eliminate flaky tests, run sanitizer and performance builds, and track coverage.

- Build AI-driven test tooling: agent-based test generation, automated dogfooding and triage, and AI-assisted PR review.

- Partner with feature engineers on testability and review designs for how they will be verified.

- Thoughtfully leverage AI tools in your workflow and set the standard for how the team uses them. 

What We Believe Are Important Traits for This Role 

- 5+ years of experience in C++17: comfortable writing test code and tooling, reading production code, and debugging with sanitizers and profilers. Python or similar for harnesses and analysis.

- Proven experience building test infrastructure for a large native codebase: test frameworks, CMake, and CI systems.

title: Software Engineer (gn) @ Industrial AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company. 

About Marentis 

Marentis develops AI-supported software for manufacturing, robotics and complex automated machinery. We turn machine data and operational information into useful knowledge for troubleshooting, decision-making and automation. Our work connects sensor measurements, machine and robot states, quality data, alarms and expert knowledge. These problems require understanding both the data and its context: a fault may originate elsewhere in a production line, and similar symptoms can have different causes. We are a small, early-stage startup where individual contributions directly shape the product. We value curiosity, initiative and people who enjoy understanding difficult problems and making things work.

The Role 

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Software Engineer with strong Python skills and sound technical judgment. You will own backend features from problem definition through implementation, testing, deployment and maintenance.

After onboarding, you should be able to investigate unfamiliar production code and independently review Python/backend pull requests: understand intended behavior, question assumptions, assess tests and failure paths, and identify effects on the wider system.

We actively encourage AI-assisted development. You remain responsible for understanding, verifying and maintaining the resulting software. We value demonstrated delivery, ownership and learning ability more than a fixed number of years in the industry.

What You Will Do 

- Build backend services, APIs and SQL-backed data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval and agent workflows.

- Read and improve existing code, review pull requests, and make informed decisions about interfaces, data models, state and failure handling.

- Design meaningful unit, integration and end-to-end tests, supported by continuous integration.

- Test with representative machine data, recorded streams and simulated device inputs, including missing measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values and connection failures.

- Reproduce bugs, inspect whether test assertions verify the intended behavior, and add useful regression coverage.

- Understand manufacturing users and equipment, contribute across integration and deployment, and communicate trade-offs and blockers early.

What You Bring 

- Strong practical Python and backend engineering skills, supported by software you personally shipped and maintained.

- Independent code-review ability: you can investigate a change, assess correctness, maintainability and security, and justify whether it is ready to merge.

- Practical system-design judgment across APIs, SQL, database design, data validation, state management and concurrency where relevant.

- Strong testing and debugging skills: you choose useful test boundaries, construct representative data and investigate failures.

- Experience making imperfect operational, machine, sensor or similarly complex data trustworthy, with an interest in its industrial meaning and consequences.

- Resourcefulness: you learn unfamiliar code and technologies through documentation, small experiments, focused questions and feedback.

- Clear written and spoken English, constructive collaboration and reliable follow-through.

We welcome different educational and professional paths. Direct manufacturing experience is especially useful; equivalent engineering depth from adjacent domains is also relevant.

Particularly Relevant Experience 

Bring depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in all of them is not expected.

- Machine data, analytics and machine learning: Time-series or sensor-data processing, curation, feature engineering, anomaly detection, condition monitoring or quality prediction. Explain how you handled timestamps, units, asset identity and data quality, and evaluated whether the result was useful.

- Knowledge graphs and retrieval: Entity and relationship modeling, graph or relational database design, provenance, versioning and conflicting information. Experience combining identifiers, aliases, lexical search and semantic retrieval, with evaluations of relevance and applicability.

- Agent systems and workflows: LLM tools, multi-agent coordination, orchestration, context and memory management, validation and failure recovery. Show how you evaluated quality, cost and latency, enforced permissions and chose appropriate execution boundaries.

- Industrial integration, robotics and automation: Connecting software with production equipment, robot cells or automated machinery through telemetry, device interfaces or protocols such as MQTT and OPC UA. Experience with simulators, physical-device testing and equipment-specific behavior is valuable. 

- Cloud deployment, containerization, observability and operating software across customer environments are also useful.

title: Platform Reliability & Performance Engineer
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

Our lab is scaling fast, and every system behind the platform takes more load each month. Customers and AI labs build automated workflows on our API, so it has to stay fast and up.

You own platform reliability and performance: observability, compute performance and cost, CI and developer tooling, and the infrastructure underneath.

What You'll Do

- Own observability. Alerts and traces the team relies on, so we see a problem before a customer does.

- Drive performance and cost. Profile and optimize our compute jobs and APIs, so throughput grows faster than cost and latency.

- Make developers fast. Fast, reliable CI, builds, deploys and local setup.

- Set reliability targets. SLOs, incident response, postmortems, and an on-call that people can live with.

- Keep the platform secure and current. Dependencies, secrets, supply chain and infra migrations, handled before they become fires.

What We're Looking For

- Production reliability experience. You have run systems where uptime and latency mattered, and you think in failure modes and SLOs.

- Performance depth. You have profiled real systems and made them measurably faster or cheaper.

- Developer-experience mindset. You treat your teammates as users.

- Strong software fundamentals. Production Python or TypeScript, plus the tests and tooling that make the work repeatable.

- Autonomous and pragmatic. You find what needs doing without a spec, and you know when to harden and when to ship.

- Technical fit. SRE, platform or backend experience. Hands-on with observability tooling, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.

- Location: London.

Application deadline 

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Forward Deployed Intern
description:
About Andercore 

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

- Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

- Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

- 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

- $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Learn how a global trading business really works, and build the AI tools that make it faster.

As a Forward Deployed Intern, you spend six months inside our business. You sit with the teams that buy, sell and move industrial materials, learn how their work really happens, and build tools that make it faster, with AI at the core.

You work alongside our product and engineering team, with a mentor who reviews your work and helps you grow. This is not a shadowing internship: you take on real problems, ship real tools, and see them used every day.

What you will do

Learn the business 

- Join our sales, procurement, logistics and finance teams and understand how a trade works from request to delivery.

- Spot where people lose time to manual work.

Build , Measure & Share 

- Build automations, small agents, scripts and dashboards with AI tools such as Claude.

- Ship first versions quickly and improve them with feedback from the people who use them.

- Track whether what you built saves time or prevents mistakes.

- Decide with your mentor what to improve and what to stop.

- Document what you built so others can use it.

- Show your work in demos to the team.

What success looks like

- Several tools or automations in daily use by our teams

- Measured time savings for at least one team

- Clear documentation others can build on

- A solid understanding of how a global trade works end to end

What you bring

- You are enrolled in a degree in computer science, engineering, business informatics or a similar field.

- You can code, for example in Python or JavaScript, and use AI tools in your daily work.

- Real curiosity about how businesses work, not only about technology.

- You communicate clearly and like working with people from other backgrounds.

- You can commit to six months full-time in Berlin.

- Fluent English. German is a plus.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €2,409.33

Through real-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via  Calix One — our cloud-first, AI-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve.

We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences.

Calix is where passionate innovators come together with a shared mission: to reimagine broadband experiences and empower communities like never before. As a true pioneer in broadband technology, we ignite transformation by equipping service providers of all sizes with an unrivaled platform, state-of-the-art cloud technologies, and AI-driven solutions that redefine what’s possible. Every tool and breakthrough we offer is designed to simplify operations and unlock extraordinary subscriber experiences through innovation. We are looking for a passionate and skilled AI Agent Development Engineer to join our team to design and build intelligent, autonomous agents that transform workflows and customer experiences. This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical expertise in AI agent frameworks and integration with enterprise systems.

This position is remote based anywhere in the US/Canada.

Key Responsibilities

- 
Design & Build AI Agents: Develop and deploy agents capable of perception, reasoning, and autonomous action.

- 
Integration: Integrate agents with existing external systems using REST APIs, microservices, and cloud platforms.

- 
Optimization: Implement best practices for performance, scalability, and security in multi-agent environments.

- 
Collaboration: Work with product managers and data scientists to align agent capabilities with business needs.

- 
Innovation: Explore emerging technologies in Generative AI, LLM orchestration, and multi-agent frameworks.

Required Skills & Qualifications :

- 10+ years in software development with exposure to AI/ML projects.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field.

- Hands-on experience in developing AI agents using frameworks like Google ADK, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.

- Strong programming skills in Go, Rust, or Python (experience with PL/SQL or Java is a plus).

- Familiarity with LLM integration, prompt engineering, and orchestration of multi-agent workflows.

- Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

- Understanding of Generative AI, NLP, and reinforcement learning concepts.

- LLM inference optimization

- Experience adapting small language models (SLMs) to domain-specific tasks using LoRA, QLoRA, and other PEFT methods (adapters, prefix tuning, DoRA)

- Understanding of instruction tuning, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and preference alignment (DPO, RLHF)

Preferred:

- Experience building custom AI agents for enterprise workflows (e.g., service request triage, summarization, proactive support).

- Working with agent lifecycle management and AI profiles for model selection and orchestration.

- Exposure to multi-agent collaboration and autonomous decision-making systems

Why Join Us?

- Be part of a team driving AI innovation in telecom and cloud solutions.

- Opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects impacting millions of users.

- Collaborative culture with continuous learning and growth.

- Competitive Benefits and Vacation package.

title: Systems Simulation & Performance Modelling - Member of Technical Staff
description:
About Us 

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.
