title: Production Engineer, Network Engineering
description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! 

How We Operate

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on 

- Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

- Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up.

- Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

- Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers.

- Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours.

- Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs.

- Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in.

- Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. 

- You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it.

- You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution.

- You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone.

- You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet.

- You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again.

- You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero.

- Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling.

title: Defense Success Manager, France
description:
About Mistral

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role 

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them): 

- Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

- Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.

What You Will Do 

Own the customer success and value plan

- Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

- Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

- Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

- Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

- Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

- Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

- Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

- Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

- Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

- Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

- Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

- Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

- Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

- Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

- Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

- Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

- Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

- Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

- Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

- Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

- Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

- Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints , including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules.

- Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion

- Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.

Nice to have

- Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs.

- Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

- Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

- Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures.

Security & Compliance criteria

- Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

- Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations).

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: AI Engineer AivyCare
description:
Bouw mee aan de toekomst van de huisartsenzorg 

Wil jij AI-oplossingen ontwikkelen die direct bijdragen aan toegankelijke en toekomstbestendige zorg? Bij PharmaPartners werk je aan AivyCare : een nieuw, intelligent platform dat huisartsen en zorgorganisaties helpt om zorgvragen slimmer, sneller en beter af te handelen. Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan toepassingen die de druk in de zorg verlagen en de continuïteit van zorg helpen borgen.

Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nog veel te bouwen en te ontdekken is. Samen met onze huidige AI engineer / architect werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AivyCare en help je technische keuzes te vertalen naar een schaalbaar en relevant product voor de zorg.

Wat ga je doen? 

Als AI Engineer werk je in een klein en gedreven team aan de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Je schakelt direct met engineering, architectuur, product en domeinkennis. Je bouwt niet alleen aan techniek, maar denkt ook mee over hoe we AI slim, veilig en schaalbaar toepassen in een product dat er echt toe doet.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

- Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen AivyCare.

- Het ontwikkelen van backend services, API-koppelingen en intelligente workflows.

- Het vertalen van ideeën en use cases naar werkende prototypes en productieklare oplossingen.

- Het toepassen van LLM’s, agentic workflows en andere AI-technieken waar die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegen.

- Het verbeteren van kwaliteit, testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid.

- Het meedenken over architectuurkeuzes, technische richting en ontwikkelstandaarden.

- Het samen met onze AI engineer / architect versnellen van de ontwikkeling van AivyCare.

Wie zoeken wij? 

Wij zoeken niet primair op senioriteit of een vast aantal jaren ervaring. Voor ons zijn mindset, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om mee te bouwen in een ondernemende omgeving belangrijker. We zoeken iemand die initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en graag werkt aan iets dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is.

Jij past waarschijnlijk goed als je:

- Hbo of wo werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur in informatica, AI, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.

- Ervaring hebt met softwareontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld in backend development, integraties of platformontwikkeling.

- Affiniteit hebt met AI-toepassingen en nieuwsgierig bent naar hoe je die inzet in echte producten.

- Pragmatisch bent en goed functioneert in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.

- Kunt meedenken van concept tot realisatie en verder kijkt dan alleen je eigen code.

- Kwaliteit belangrijk vindt en begrijpt dat betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid in de zorg essentieel zijn.

- Goed kunt samenwerken met product, architectuur en andere disciplines.

- Enthousiast wordt van onze technologie stack: Java 25, Spring Boot Modulith, FHIR R4, PostgreSQL, Keycloak, React/Vite, Azure Cloud Provider.

- Enthousiast bent over agentic development met Claude Code.

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel, maar ligt je kracht meer in fullstack, frontend development of operations? Reageer dan gerust. We zoeken bouwers met de juiste mindset; de exacte invulling van de rol bepalen we samen.

Wat bieden wij jou? 

Bij PharmaPartners krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw AI-gedreven product voor de eerstelijnszorg. Je werkt in een omgeving waar technologie, productontwikkeling en maatschappelijke relevantie samenkomen.

Wij bieden jou onder andere:

- Een marktconform salaris: tussen €2972 en €5507 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), passend bij jouw ervaring en niveau als Developer. 

- 26 vakantiedagen + 8,33% vakantiegeld: o.b.v. een fulltime (40 uur p/w) dienstverband.

- Een goede pensioenregeling: met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%.

- Jaarlijks €500,- persoonlijk budget: wat je kunt besteden aan sport en persoonlijke groei.

- Hybride werken: hybride werken betekent bij ons dat je minimaal 3 á 4 dagen per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een gezonde balans tussen interactie en flexibiliteit.

- Een uitdagende rol: met veel invloed en verantwoordelijkheid.

- De kans om vanaf een vroeg stadium mee te bouwen aan AivyCare: een nieuw platform in de eerstelijnszorg.

- Sporten onder werktijd: bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag- en donderdagmiddag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s te gaan bootcampen.

- Een hechte, open werksfeer: ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en sterke teamspirit.

- Veel ruimte voor initiatief, ontwikkeling en ondernemerschap. 

Enthousiast? 

Wil jij bouwen aan AI-oplossingen die echt verschil maken in de (huisartsen)zorg? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role 

The Senior Engineer, AI / ML — Self-Serve Toolchain will build the end-to-end system that lets customers adapt UFORCE models on their own private data without exposing that data to us.

This role spans data processing, foundation-model-assisted labeling, human-in-the-loop QA, active learning, training, evaluation, and model promotion . You will turn an in-flight principal-led capability into a repeatable toolchain that non-expert customers can run safely on-site.

What you’ll do 

- Own the ML adaptation pipeline from raw customer data to trained, evaluated, deployable models.

- Build foundation-model-assisted labeling workflows using tools such as SAM-2 , Grounding DINO , open-vocabulary models, LLM steering, and human review.

- Design self-serve operator workflows using yes/no/maybe feedback and natural-language corrections.

- Create versioned datasets with lineage, data cards, label provenance, class distributions, and known gaps.

- Build QA methods that catch systematic pseudo-label errors, missing annotations, and long-tail data gaps.

- Develop active-learning loops that prioritize the highest-value frames for limited operator review.

- Build reproducible train/eval pipelines with experiment tracking, model packaging, and promotion gates.

- Design evaluation around held-out anchor sets, leakage prevention, baselines, slice metrics, and automated approve/reject decisions.

- Package the toolchain for on-prem, air-gapped, regulated, or customer-held environments.

- Close the field-failure loop by feeding live failures back into the next tune cycle.

- Lead and grow a small specialist team around curation, auto-labeling, deployment, and onboarding.

What success looks like 

- Customers can run a full adaptation cycle without engineer intervention.

- Customer data stays inside the customer boundary.

- The system produces trusted datasets with clear provenance and quality signals.

- Pseudo-label quality is measured and systematic errors are caught early.

- The promotion gate can approve or reject models based on evidence, not intuition.

- Evaluation is protected by anchor sets, leakage controls, slice metrics, and baseline comparisons.

- Field failures become reproducible inputs to the next training cycle.

- Synthetic data is used only when it proves value against real held-out data.

- The toolchain becomes a repeatable capability supported by a small, ramped team.

Required Qualifications 

- 5+ years building production ML, AI, or computer-vision systems.

- Strong Python and PyTorch.

- Experience owning ML data pipelines, training pipelines, or evaluation infrastructure.

- Deep CV data experience: detection, segmentation, annotation taxonomies, dataset curation, and data quality.

- Hands-on experience with model-in-the-loop or foundation-model-assisted labeling.

- Familiarity with tools such as SAM-2 , Grounding DINO , FiftyOne , and annotation platforms.

- Strong understanding of evaluation: held-out sets, leakage prevention, baselines, slice metrics, and promotion gates.

- Experience with QA sampling, label-noise analysis, missing annotations, IAA, or alternatives when only one operator is available.

- Experience with active learning or other methods for prioritizing labeling effort.

- Ability to reason about dataset economics: quality vs. quantity, long-tail coverage, and cost-per-useful-example.

- Experience with dataset versioning, lineage, experiment tracking, model registries, or data cards.

- Strong ownership, communication, and systems thinking.

- Experience leading engineers as a tech lead, staff engineer, or small-team manager.

Nice to have 

- Synthetic data, sim2real, or domain randomization experience.

- EO / IR / LWIR, remote sensing, maritime imagery, or small-object detection experience.

- Privacy-preserving ML, federated learning, on-prem, or air-gapped deployment experience.

- Experience building self-serve ML platforms or tools for non-expert users.

- Experience with lakeFS , DVC , MLflow , Weights & Biases , Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Flyte, Dagster, Airflow, or Argo.

- LLM application, context engineering, structured output, or LLM evaluation experience.

- Exposure to radar, AIS, EO/IR fusion, tracking, sensor fusion, robotics, autonomy, UxV, defence tech, C2/C4ISR, or tactical systems.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

title: Senior Software Engineer - Engine Orchestration
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: 

The Engine Orchestration team builds and operates the distributed services that run, scale and balance the analytical query engines. We are the layer that turns a customer's model into something they and their AI agents can query interactively using our Process Query Language across enterprise-sized datasets.

The team actively evolves our new premium query engine, collaborating with multiple other teams across time zones. New features, improved operationability, robust security, and allowing for scalable customer workloads are ours to design and ship.

Our defining program right now is a multi-year migration of the query engine that has powered Celonis for years onto our new premium query engine. It is one of the largest and highest-leverage engineering efforts in the company.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead both the engineering that evolves the new premium query engine and the execution of milestones within the migration program that moves customer workloads onto it.

This is not a lift and shift. The two query engines evolved with different focus areas and the new premium query engine serves different forward looking use cases, so the job is keeping customer workloads running seamlessly throughout. You will analyze how the engines differ on real customer workloads, develop tooling, classify the root causes, and turn them into concrete follow up actions across teams.

Continuous operations are a crucial part of your job. You will help keep the engines and their orchestration healthy while the entire fleet moves underneath them, because a migration on this scale does not get a pause in customer traffic to work with.

Your work at Celonis will directly impact companies and people around the globe as they improve their processes to save money, reduce waste, improve automation and generally become more efficient.

The work you’ll do: 

- Lead the design and delivery of the services our team owns across new and existing microservices in Java, Spring, RabbitMQ and Postgres, from architecture through to production operation

- Evolve the new premium query engine by owning and delivering entire feature sets addressing new and extended use cases, tightened security robustness, and closing gaps

- Drive query engine migration milestones end to end and ensure operationability across their shared libraries as dependency workflows grow more frequent and complex

- Establish and extend AI agent tooling to carry repetitive operational and development processes across our team

- Sustain the operational and security robustness of our Tier 0 and Tier 1 services throughout feature development and the migration, and take part and improve how the on-call rotation works

The qualifications you need: 

- University degree in Computer Science or comparable education

- 5+ years of professional experience building Java applications that are scalable, reliable and testable, including owning it in production

- Fluency in Java and Python is required

- Strong experience with data-intensive, performance-critical distributed systems

- Experience rolling out changes across a large fleet of distributed systems, and the instinct for incremental, reversible, measurable steps that comes with it

- A track record of developing and operating systems that process data workloads at scale

- Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms from a performance point of view, and of asynchronous and concurrent programming

- Ability to turn a vague, customer-facing problem into a concrete executable plan, and to explain that plan to stakeholders who are not engineers

- Excellent communication skills in English, German is a plus

- Preferred experience: Java Spring Boot, Kubernetes, Databases, C++

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video .

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process .

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

description:
Headquarters: Europe - Remote

About Us 

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Job Brief

We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.

Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher

Your main responsibilities will include:

- 
Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;

- 
Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;

- 
Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;

- 
Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;

Key Requirements

- 
You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

- 
You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)

- 
Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence

- 
A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.

- 
You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.

- 
Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;

- 
Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;

- 
You have security or risk control experience as a plus.

- 
You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.

- 
English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.

Why Join Us 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-blockchain-risk-control-lead

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

- You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

- You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

- You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

- Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts

- Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident

- Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives

- Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

- Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response

- Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal

- Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python

- Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis

- Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams

- Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux

- Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews

- Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services

- Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.

- This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has: 

- 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience

- GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification

- Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: AI Engineer
description:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) AI Engineer ! 

Missions

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots

En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :

- ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids

- c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. 

C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :

- une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises

- l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc.

- la valorisation des données de paie et sociales , pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…

L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.

🚀 Tes responsabilités

Ta mission : faire de l'IA le levier qui démultiplie le travail de chacun chez Alassio. L'objectif est assumé : multiplier par 10 la productivité de chaque membre de l'équipe.

- Tu formes la Growth squad avec notre Founding Strategy & Operations : ce binôme transverse optimise l'existant, automatise les workflows de toutes les équipes et fait passer nos initiatives IA et nos outils internes à l'échelle : hébergement et mise en production dans des environnements partagés, sécurité, observabilité, optimisation et amélioration continue

- Tu deviens le (la) référent(e) IA d'Alassio : on se veut profondément AI-native et on expérimente énormément. Tu centralises et coordonnes ces initiatives pour que ce "lab interne" soit efficace, et tu expérimentes aussi en continu avec toutes les techno IA (budget et outillage conséquents)

- Tu construis la nouvelle colonne vertébrale IT d'Alassio , en identifiant les systèmes IA qui comptent à l'échelle de toute l'entreprise

- Tu prépares l'avenir du produit : à terme, les usages testés et éprouvés en interne sous ton impulsion ont vocation à rejoindre notre plateforme. Ils nourriront le « People OS » qui démocratise les cas d'usage les plus pertinents de l'IA dans notre secteur

🧭 Tes premiers chantiers

Ton point de départ : Bedrock, notre OS interne. Un peu à la manière de Palantir Foundry, il agrège & orchestre tout le contexte de l'entreprise pour en tirer des actions concrètes : suivi ultra-personnalisé et automatisé de nos utilisateurs, analyse produit, documentation, rédaction de tickets et PR associées…

Bedrock est déjà au cœur du quotidien de toutes les équipes. Mais il s'est construit par couches successives, au fil des cas d'usage ajoutés. Ton premier objectif est d'en dresser l'inventaire complet, process et outils IA compris. Tu définis ensuite la roadmap qui le fera changer de dimension :

- Workflows : optimiser l'existant

- Infrastructure : sécurité, confidentialité, hébergement et environnements partagés, pour un OS multi-joueur, plug-and-play et scalable

- Observabilité : suivre les agents et leur performance, et améliorer chaque logique en continu

- Autonomie : construire des workflows agentiques déclenchés par webhook ou planifiés, qui nettoient le contexte et mènent des missions 24/7

Très vite, tu as vocation à devenir le (la) responsable qui orchestre l'IA chez Alassio, et le (la) référent(e) de notre OS Bedrock.

Profil recherché

🌱 Expérience

- 1 à 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle d'AI Engineer / FDE / AI Deployment Strategist dans une top structure tech (BCGX, Palantir, Dust)

- Plusieurs missions concrètes de déploiement et d'optimisation de technologies IA : mise en place de zéro d'un workflow au sein d'une organisation, sujets de gouvernance et de déploiement en entreprise, etc.

- Une utilisation intensive des outils IA et une bonne maîtrise de Python : Claude Code / Codex ; Cursor Agents, Linear/PostHog, déploiement et hébergement (cloud, AI routers, etc.) 

💎 Qualités

- Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables

- Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic

- Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme

Processus de sélection

- Premier entretien avec Tancrède (CEO) : 45 min

- Étude de cas technique avec Hector (COO) et Ivan Robert (Founding SWE) : 1h30

- Rencontre informelle de l'équipe dans nos bureaux, puis échange de 45 min avec les fondateurs Ayoub (CAIO), Paul (CTO), Tancrède (CEO) & Hector (COO)

- Deux à trois prises de référence

Ce que nous offrons

👊 Une mission unique

Tu rejoins une aventure entrepreneuriale en plein passage à l'échelle, sur un marché verrouillé depuis des années. On est convaincus que l'IA ne transformera pas seulement le produit et secteur qu'on construit, mais aussi la façon avec laquelle toutes les entreprises devront se réinventer. On en fait déjà l'expérience au quotidien avec Bedrock, notre OS interne qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de l'activité de toutes nos équipes tech et non-tech.

Ton rôle est de faire passer ce laboratoire à l'échelle pour que chaque équipe d'Alassio aille plus vite, avec l'ambition assumée de bâtir une référence en matière d'organisation AI-native. 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

- 💰 Package de 70 à 90K€ + BSPCE

- 🏥 Mutuelle Alan 

- 🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant)

- 💻 Top matériel IT (MacOS, écran incurvé)

- 🤓 Offsite légendaires

➡️ Prochaines étapes

title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
description:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

title: Expression of Interest - Internships
description:
About Us 

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Internship - Expression of Interest 

We're always interested in hearing from exceptional students who want to work on the hardest problems in AI infrastructure - bringing novel accelerators to life, building the systems that orchestrate them, and charting the new territories of what heterogeneous compute can do.

There's no formal internship programme or fixed cycle here - internships happen when the need and the right person come together. This form is how we keep track of who to reach out to when that happens. If you think you have unique skills to contribute, or are studying or have experience in any of the following, we'd love to hear from you:

- High-performance systems and low-level performance engineering

- Inference infrastructure, orchestration, or distributed systems

- Hardware bring-up, kernel development, or accelerator programming

- Simulation, modelling, or workload design

This is a general interest form rather than an application for a specific internship. We review all submissions on an ongoing basis and will reach out when we see a strong match and the right opportunity comes up.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. 

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

A l’heure actuelle, face aux besoins croissants d’acteurs pour accompagner les transitions des entreprises et de leurs écosystèmes territoriaux et industriels, Mines Saint-Etienne, dans le cadre du projet Phygital financé par la région AURA, a décidé de massifier ses formations i) en s’appuyant sur des pratiques innovantes en direction de publics hétérogènes (formation initiale, formation tout au long de la vie, formation par la recherche), et ii) en se basant sur de nombreux cas d’usages technologiques (Intelligence Artificielle, Sciences des données, Jumeaux Numériques, Gestion de production, etc), démonstrateurs des enjeux actuels de l’industrie et des territoires du futur. title: Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais)
description:
Product Manager, Device Data Management (Français/Anglais) 

Lieu : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Niveau : Senior Product Manager
Équipe : Device Data Management (DDM)
Contrat : CDI

À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. 

Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais . À propos de Kaluza 

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez : 

Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran.

- Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données.

- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France.

- Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

- Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats.

- Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie.

Ce que vous apportez : 

Critères essentiels :

- Une expérience avérée en tant que Product Manager, Business Analyst ou équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un solide historique de localisation réussie de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux

- Un français courant et une grande aisance en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre

- De l’aisance dans le travail direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les décideurs alignés et impliqués

- Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard·e et opérationnel·le, vous préférez construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt qu’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous pouvez tenir une conversation technique. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur·e, mais vous raisonnez comme tel·le, et vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour réfléchir à un modèle de données que pour penser à ce que l’utilisateur voit à l’écran

- Une communication claire et incisive, capable de faire le tri dans le bruit et d’expliquer la complexité technique et de marché à des interlocuteurs variés, clients compris, ainsi qu’une expérience de collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (ingénierie, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery, etc.) pour livrer des solutions localisées

Idéalement, vous avez :

- Une expérience dans le secteur de l’énergie en France : vous connaissez le fonctionnement du marché et ses acteurs clés (ex. Enedis / GRDF), notamment sur les données d’équipements et les flux de marché

- Une expérience avec des plateformes de gestion de l’énergie ou de services publics (utilities) sur le marché français

- Une bonne maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la découverte et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération

- Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

- Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

- Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

- Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

- Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages 

- Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès x3) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

- Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

- Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + jours de RTT, congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break)

Venez comme vous êtes 

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre page carrières et sur LinkedIn . Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible ici .

We're looking for a Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting to join our team remotely! You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, regulatory reporting, and compliance operations in a fast-paced, high-scrutiny environment where accuracy and audit-readiness are non-negotiable.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with deep knowledge of compliance regulations and frameworks. You'll own end-to-end data management from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and insights for compliance and leadership teams. You will also automate compliance processes and workflows to boost efficiency and minimize human error.

If you combine exceptional data analysis expertise with solid knowledge of compliance regulations, a keen eye for regulatory risk, and the drive to shape the future of crypto with a top-tier brand - this is your next mission!

What you bring

- Strong communicator who can simplify complex data ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences

Nice to haves

title: AI Research Scientist
description:
About the Science and AI Team 

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair. 

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

About the Role 

The AI Research Scientist works at the intersection of AI, psychometrics and research, ensuring that Maki’s automated scoring systems are scientifically robust, fair, and continuously improving.

1. Evaluating and testing LLMs for scoring 

- Assess the accuracy and reliability of LLMs used for automated scoring, such as structured grids, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency (written and spoken).

- Benchmark closed- and open-source models across assessment types and languages.

- Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

- Explore prompt engineering and model optimisation, and recommend which models and prompts go into production.

2. Building our own scoring models 

- Move our scoring onto self-hosted open-weight models, and fine-tune them on expert-rated data where they can beat frontier models.

- Check every model switch keeps accuracy, reliability and fairness at least as good as today's.

3. Comparing AI with human judgement, and calibrating psychometric models 

- Design studies that compare AI scores with expert ratings, against both individual experts and expert averages, to establish agreement and validity.

- Develop hybrid scoring pipelines with engineering that combine human oversight with AI scoring.

- Evaluate and calibrate psychometric models for validity and comparability across populations and test forms.

4. Bias and fairness analysis 

- Detect and analyse bias in AI-generated and psychometric scores across demographic groups, including subgroup analysis.

- Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

- Contribute to fairness dashboards and compliance documentation that support transparent model governance.

5. Predictive analytics and performance insights 

- Model the relationship between candidate scores and job performance and retention, using large assessment and performance datasets.

- Develop and test models that estimate success probabilities or identify behavioural and linguistic predictors of performance.

- Work with data science, implementation and customer success teams to turn findings into recommendations for clients and colleagues.

6. Research output 

- Publish reports, papers and conference presentations, internal and external.

- Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues and clients.

As one of Maki People's early employees, you'll help shape the team's future. 

Our Ideal Candidate 

Required 

- PhD or MSc in machine learning, computational linguistics, data science or psychology.

- A track record of publications, such as peer-reviewed papers or conference papers.

- Hands-on experience evaluating LLMs: designing benchmarks, measuring agreement with human raters, and testing consistency and robustness of model output.

- Experience testing AI-driven decisions for fairness and bias.

- Proficiency in Python or R, with experience in statistical analysis.

- Clear communication of results to scientific and business audiences.

Preferred 

- Experience with NLP techniques for automated scoring.

- Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

- Experience working with cloud databases and large datasets.

- Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT, and how they apply to assessment design and validation.

- Working knowledge of ethical AI, data governance and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

- Experience working with engineering, product and content teams.

Application Process 

- Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

- Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

- Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

- Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

- Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

- Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

title: Staff Software Engineer (Autonomy)
description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role 

The Staff Software Engineer (Autonomy) will design, build, and operate software capabilities that improve the mission effectiveness and safety of uncrewed surface vehicles across the UFORCE C2/C4ISR stack.

This role spans Perception Autonomy, Autonomy Behaviours —including collision avoidance (COLAV), target-based manoeuvring and engagement—and Swarm Intelligence . You will take cross-system initiatives from design and implementation through scenario-based verification, field trials, deployment, and iteration.

The role requires strong software engineering and mathematical foundations, with an emphasis on autonomy that remains safe, observable, and useful in real operating conditions—including degraded sensors, different sea states, and GNSS- or RF-challenged environments.

What you’ll do

- Build production-grade capabilities across perception, autonomous behaviours, COLAV, and multi-USV coordination.

- Define measurable acceptance criteria for autonomy performance, safety, reliability, and operator trust.

- Validate perception and behaviours across day/night operations, different sea states, sensor degradation, and GNSS/RF-challenged conditions.

- Develop swarm capabilities such as task allocation, role assignment, formation control, and distributed sensing.

- Build scenario libraries, replay tooling, automated metrics, and CI gates to prevent regressions.

- Introduce structured logging, playback, and failure classification to accelerate field diagnosis.

- Build operator controls and safeguards that enable crews to use autonomy without continuous engineering support.

- Collaborate with platform, C2, product, and field teams to define clear interfaces and deliver cross-system capabilities.

What success looks like

- Perception and COLAV meet agreed performance and safety criteria in representative trials.

- Swarm capabilities are used routinely in multi-USV exercises and degrade safely under constraints.

- Operators can configure and use autonomy without day-to-day engineering intervention.

- Automated scenario testing prevents safety and reliability regressions.

- Field failures can be reproduced and diagnosed within an agreed timeframe.

- Capabilities have documented operating envelopes, limitations, and evidence of field readiness.

Required qualifications

- 8+ years of production software or backend engineering experience.

- Strong experience with Java, Python, or .NET/C# .

- Strong mathematical foundations relevant to autonomy and robotics.

- Experience with distributed, real-time, event-driven, or mission-critical systems.

- Understanding of sockets, UDP, latency, packet loss, and low-level protocols.

- Strong testing, observability, debugging, and operational ownership.

- Clear communication and cross-team collaboration skills.

Nice to have

- Experience with C++, Rust, or C .

- Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles, maritime autonomy, or UxV systems.

- Knowledge of perception, sensor fusion, navigation, planning, or control systems.

- Experience with COLAV, simulation, replay tooling, or multi-agent systems.

- Experience in defence, C2/C4ISR, or constrained operating environments.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.
