title: Data Engineer
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

- ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

Data Engineer 

About Mirakl 

Mirakl is the leading provider of eCommerce software solutions. Mirakl's suite of solutions provides enterprises with a transformative way to drive significant growth and efficiency in their online business.

Since 2012, Mirakl has been pioneering the platform economy, empowering retail and B2B enterprises with the most advanced, secure, and scalable technology to digitize and expand product assortment through marketplace and dropship, improve efficiency in supplier catalog management and payments, personalize shopping experiences, and boost profits through retail media.

In July 2025, Mirakl launched Mirakl Nexus, the first neutral infrastructure designed for agentic commerce. Built on Mirakl's 13 years of expertise and innovation, and powered by an ecosystem of more than 100,000 sellers, Mirakl Nexus connects merchants and AI agents to automate product discovery, payments, and after-sales service.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris, with 4 days on-site per week. 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Data Experience squad led by Alexandre Blanchard , Data Engineering Manager within Mirakl's broader Data team of 70 specialists. Together, you'll be building and scaling the ML infrastructure that powers Mirakl's AI-driven products from real-time recommendation inference to LLM fine-tuning pipelines serving some of the world's most innovative e-commerce players.

2. Your Impact

- Design and implement a performant, robust, and scalable ML Platform architecture — covering training, evaluation, and inference — while keeping costs under control

- Maintain and improve ML production pipelines and real-time inference applications at scale (real-time recommendation inference, 1M+ LLM calls/week, async content moderation)

- Partner with Data Scientists from project kickoff through productionization — setting up best practices, guardrails, and CI/CD improvements in collaboration with the SRE team

- Drive technical excellence: manage technical debt, systematize version upgrade processes, and upskill team members on MLOps and Data Engineering topics

- Contribute to cutting-edge AI projects — including LoRA adapter creation for open-source LLM fine-tuning, in-house computer vision models, and large-scale product data transformation — and share findings across Labs teams

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience: 

- 2+ years of experience in a Machine Learning and/or Data engineering environment

- Proven track record of shipping ML applications at scale (NLP, image processing, or classical ML) in high-volume, production-grade systems

- Background in software development with a strong appetite for data science and machine learning

Skills: 

- Proficiency in Python and the Kubernetes/Docker ecosystem

- Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS primarily) and Apache ecosystem frameworks

- Hands-on knowledge of an orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)

- Familiarity with CI/CD practices and MLOps principles (monitoring, model lifecycle, reproducibility)

- Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences

4. Tech Stack

Experience with: Python, Databricks, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, TensorFlow, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, KServe, Delta Lake, Kubernetes, SQL, Terraform, Apache Spark

5. Languages

- French: Fluent (C2 level required)

- English: Fluent (B2/C1 level required) 

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

- A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

- An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.

- 1 hour discussion with your futur manager 

- 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

Want to learn more about how we build our AI infrastructure? Read our latest article: Open source at the core, proprietary where it counts: Mirakl's AI inference platform — by Jeanine Harb, Antoine Bourgault and Maxime Roodnejad, Senior Data Engineers at Mirakl.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics. 

What you’ll be doing 

- Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.

- Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.

- Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.

- Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.

- Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).

- Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.

- Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.

- Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

What you must have 

- Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.

- A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.

- Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models).

- Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.).

- Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation.

- Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.

- Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch)

Get some bonus points 

- PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.

- Publications at top-tier conferences.

- Experience in managing a software team.

- Ability to write production-level code in modern C++

title: Senior Software Engineer (AppSec)
description:
About us

Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users’ code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month.

About the role

You’ll own security at Trigger.dev: our infrastructure, our app, the runtime that runs our users’ code, and the secrets they trust us with.

Some of our customers let their own users run code on Trigger.dev (think coding agents running whatever instructions they’re given). That code must never reach our systems or our customers’ systems. Keeping it contained is a feature we ship, so this is a product engineering role as much as a security one.

About half to three quarters of your time will be backend engineering. The rest is hunting for problems and fixing them. When you find something, you own the fix. You’ll set your own priorities and work with others when necessary.

We’re looking for an application security (AppSec) engineer who builds: a senior backend engineer who brings a security mindset to everything they ship.

What you’ll do

- Sandbox and runtime security. Design and harden the environments that isolate untrusted user code. This is the core of the role.

- Security features for customers. Build things like end-to-end encrypted secrets, log redaction, private networking, and runtime hardening.

- Automated offensive testing. Use AI tools to attack our own systems on a schedule, find weak spots, and fix them. Bring in outside pen testers when it’s worth it.

- Detection and response. Build monitoring and alerting for suspicious activity, improve our security observability, and lead the response when something needs a look.

- Vulnerability management. Run scanning and triage, own our vulnerability disclosure program, and handle incoming reports.

- Automated quality. Own our security PR reviews, automated scans, fixes, and triage.

- Write it down. Document how we do security so the rest of the team can answer customer questions with confidence.

- Security habits. Help the engineering team build secure habits with reviews, docs, and light guardrails.

Like everyone at Trigger.dev, you’ll also help in our Discord and GitHub community, write docs, and create content like blog posts, code examples, and videos.

What we’re looking for

- Senior backend engineer. You design and ship production backend systems yourself.

- AppSec experience. You’ve done hands-on application security work, such as secure code review, threat modelling, pen testing, CTFs or bug bounties. You don’t need a security job title or to have run a security team.

- Cloud operations. You’ve run production systems in the cloud.

- Multi-tenant systems. You’ve built or secured systems where many customers share the same infrastructure.

- TypeScript. You’re comfortable working in it. Our codebase also uses Go and Rust.

- AI-forward. You use AI tools to automate testing, detection, and defense.

- Startup pace. You’ve worked somewhere a step or two ahead of where we are, so you know what good looks like at our size.

- Owner’s mindset. You take work off the team’s plate and fix what you find.

- On call. Reliability and security response are shared across the team.

- In-person time. You’re open to team events a few times a year.

You’ll stand out if you have

- Built or hardened sandboxes: containers, microVMs, gVisor, Firecracker, WASM, or similar.

- Secured platforms where customers have their own customers.

- A track record in bug bounties or CTFs.

- Contributed to open source.

- Worked at a developer tools, infrastructure, or open source company.

- Experience with Go or Rust.

Benefits

- Compensation and equity. Generous, transparent pay, plus equity so everyone shares in the company’s success.

- Async working. Need a heads-down day or a meeting-free day? No problem.

- Home office. We help with equipment so you’re as productive at home as in the office.

- Vacation. 25 days plus national holidays, sick leave, and generous parental leave.

- Training budget. An annual budget for books, courses, or an Audible subscription.

- Pension. Join our company scheme, or we’ll pay into your private pension.

Our values

- We’re proud to be open source. We believe in the open source community and in building a great free-to-use product.

- We ship uncomfortably fast. Moving fast is key for a startup. We’re pragmatic about what we build and when.

- We work autonomously. We decide as a team what will help our customers most, and prioritize from there.

title: AI Senior Engineer (Graph)
description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. 

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. 

What you’ll be doing 

We are seeking someone who views the Knowledge Graph not just as a database, but as a living organism that requires constant care, feeding, and pruning. You understand that a RAG system is only as good as the data underlying it. You are intrigued by the complexity of ingesting massive, messy datasets and transforming them into clean, connected knowledge.

In short, someone who likes:

- Architecting Graph ETL: Designing and developing robust ETL pipelines specifically for graph ingestion. You aren't just dumping rows into tables; you are determining how disparate data sources connect, evolve, and relate in a graph structure.

- Data Ingestion at Scale: Managing high-volume data streams using tools like Kafka and implementing CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns to ensure the graph reflects real-time reality.

- Automated Graph Hygiene: Writing scripts and jobs for deduplication , orphan node detection , and data consistency checks. You take pride in a clean schema.

- Modeling Time: Handling complex temporal relationships (e.g., how property ownership or financial status changes over time) within the graph.

- Performance Tuning: Ensuring that as the graph grows (25k+ reports and beyond), the underlying query performance remains snappy through optimizing indexes and storage.

What we’re looking for 

We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps.

Ideally, they would also have:

- Neo4j Expertise (Must Have): 4+ years of hands-on experience. You master Cypher , schema design, and the operational side of managing a production graph.

- ETL & Pipeline Mastery: Strong background in building data pipelines. You know how to take raw data, clean it, and structure it for graph ingestion.

- Streaming & CDC: Familiarity with event streaming platforms like Kafka and Change Data Capture methodologies to sync operational databases with the graph.

- Python Proficiency: Strong Python skills for writing ingestion scripts, maintenance jobs, and custom graph algorithms.

- Data Integrity Focus: Experience implementing automated jobs for entity resolution , deduplication, and quality assurance.

Nice-to-Have: 

- C# Knowledge: Ability to read or contribute to C# codebases.

- Domain Experience: Prior work in Finance or Real Estate sectors.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

- To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.

- Payments made in USD.

- 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.

- Wellness + Remote Stipend

- AI Voucher

About Able 

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

Everything dumbed down into a pre-packaged product. Startups began turning their offerings into walled gardens. Platforms took precedence over protocols. APIs and access and data export went away. And then the rent-seeking began. The era of ownership ended. Corporate Memphis. Jesus Christ. We’ve rallied a massive community to build MIT/Apache-licensed alternatives to Adobe, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Autodesk, SolidWorks, Slack, Discord, Unreal Engine, OpenRouter, RunPod, and more. The goal is full feature parity, with code anyone can own, inspect, modify, and build on. We’re digesting second-class apps and platforms into first-class applications, libraries, and APIs with full MCP support. We’re distilling out the good parts, and we’re building the connective tissue that draws them together. 100% of the internet is going to be open source soon, and we’re going to force it open. Loudly. We have eight figures in run rate revenue, over 20M app downloads and growing. Our community is the best part, and it’s energetic like a wildfire. Everyone resonates with our mission. We’re missionaries, not mercenaries. We are going to slay the incumbents by being better. Our motto is Google’s old motto - “Don't be evil (tm)”. We’re a tiny team looking for strong engineers to own major parts of the product: desktop apps, lots of completely open source backend infrastructure, agent workflows, agentic app factories. Stack: Rust, a sprinkle of TypeScript/React, egui, Tauri, MySQL/Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes. Lots and lots of Rust. We’re systems engineers by trade, but we like to vibe code Rust. Did I say Rust? Rust. Rust Rust Rust. Maybe that's a filter. You have to be self-directed and independent. If you want to open source Salesforce with half your time, do it! If you want to work on Solidworks 3D printing applications, great! Writing music apps and DAWs? Go for it! Custom Discord/Slack clients for our custom, completely open source chat API and platform? Hell yeah. Our organization is flat, and we're going to go after everybody and everything. Everything you build here will be open source. We have no private repos. We can reclaim the internet. That’s our mission. Want to know more about us? Look up “Adobe ArtCraft” on YouTube / TikTok / your platform of choice. If this resonates with you, email hn@storyteller.ai with your Github, a little about yourself and something you’ve built. Write the sentence, “don’t take my RAM, Sam!” so we know you’re one of the good guys.

We only hire through , using TestGorilla assessments, video interviews and reference checks. We may contact you first on LinkedIn, but after that we only email from Teamtailor (@ / ) or @ addresses.
We will never ask you for money, interview you on Telegram or WhatsApp, or ask you to install software, connect a wallet or run code.
Not sure if a message is really from us? Ask us through our LinkedIn page before you reply.

You know Bitrefill , and you’ve probably watched a search result or an app listing turn into revenue. You get that search no longer means just Google: people ask Claude and ChatGPT, and agents shop on their behalf. You want to own how 1M+ customers across 180+ countries find us. If that’s you, hit the apply button and let’s talk.

If you need more info to decide, keep reading. We kept the corporate fluff out, so it won't take long.

About the role Organic discovery is changing fast. Programmatic SEO still matters, and so do the app stores. Now there’s a third channel: AI answer engines and AI agents that research, compare, and buy without ever opening a browser tab. We want Bitrefill to be the default answer in all three.

You’ll have real freedom here. You choose where to build pages at scale, which experiments to run, and how to make us readable for machines. You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering to get it shipped.

What you'll do

- Own Bitrefill ’s organic growth strategy across search, app stores and AI

- Build and scale programmatic SEO: find the page types worth generating, then ship, measure and iterate

- Optimize our iOS and Android app listings with product and design: keywords, screenshots, store tests

- Make Bitrefill show up in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and whatever comes next)

- Make Bitrefill easy for AI agents to find and buy from: structured product data, machine-readable pages, and our agentic commerce work

- Write and shape content, and get your hands dirty in the front end when it’s faster than waiting on a ticket

- Track what’s working, kill what isn’t, and share findings with the team

What we're looking for

- Be based in a timezone that aligns with Europe or the Americas

- 5+ years in growth, SEO, or performance marketing, with a track record of moving organic numbers

- Deep, hands-on programmatic and technical SEO experience. You’ve built pages at scale, not just audited them

- You’ve done hands-on GEO / AI visibility work and can show what it changed;

- AI is part of how you work (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). This is non-negotiable for us

- Comfortable with front-end basics. Some React is great, and vibecoding the rest is fine

- Strong writer with a good eye for design

- Data-driven. You read Search Console and analytics like a P&L

- Self-driven. You spot the opportunity and push it forward instead of waiting for a roadmap

Bonus points

- Real ASO experience on iOS and Android

- Experience with structured data, llms.txt, or agent-facing APIs and MCP

- Crypto-native. You use it, and nobody needs to explain Bitcoin to you

- Experience in e-commerce or marketplace SEO with large catalogs

- Design chops in Figma for store assets and landing pages

Why Bitrefill 

We've been quietly right about something since 2014: internet money should just work. Fully remote since day one. Team across 30+ countries. Get paid in crypto if you want. No bullshit meetings. Twice a year, we meet up to build together in person. The rest of the time: work hard, get shit done.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. 

Boulevard customers are passionate about what they do. Their needs are nuanced and critical, and they rely on us to stand alongside them so they can focus on what they do best. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Ecosystem team, you’ll set the technical direction for Boulevard’s external developer platform and its app and integrations ecosystem, then work across teams to make it real.

This is a green field opportunity. You’ll shape the API platform, the partner experience, and the foundations partners and customers depend on, including API security, identity and access, audit trails, and eventing infrastructure. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. title: Regional Principal Analyst, Falcon Complete (Remote)
description:
Headquarters: Missouri, United States

URL: http://www.crowdstrike.com 

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role: 

The Regional Principal Analyst is the most senior technical individual contributor within a Falcon Complete region, serving as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and their immediate leadership teams. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across multiple fireteams, supporting on complex incident response, conducting deep technical case review, identifying operations and product improvement opportunities, and driving technical quality across regional operations through various technical deliverables. The Regional Principal Analyst maintains deep, current expertise through regular hands-on engagement, and collaboration in complex service delivery scenarios.

What You'll Do: 

Technical Leadership: 

- Serve as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership Team on all Falcon Complete service delivery matters 
- Ensure technical consistency, quality standards, and best practices across regional operations 
- Lead regional technical initiatives 
- Coordinate with other Regional Principals to ensure global consistency and knowledge sharing

Technical Escalation Support: 

- Serve as a technical escalation resource for Fireteam Principal Analysts on complex or ambiguous cases, providing second opinion, additional analysis, and technical guidance, while assisting with Principal technical development 
- Fireteam Principal Analysts retain ownership and lead of high-severity incident response; the Regional Principal supports as a technical resource, and highlights opportunities to improve the Falcon Complete service and technical excellence of the region. 
- Perform independent technical analysis when asked to validate or extend a fireteam's findings 

Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance: 

- Conduct technical QA reviews of closed cases across fireteams against defined criteria with documented findings 
- Identify detection gaps, false-positive patterns, and coverage opportunities from regional case data; route findings to relevant teams as improvement requests 
- Identify opportunities for tooling, telemetry, or workflow improvements based on recurring case patterns 
- Identify regional trends in detection patterns, threat landscape, and case quality 
- Identify skill gaps and development opportunities across the regional analyst population 
- Drive adoption of consistent operational standards and agentic toolsets across regional operations. 

Cross-Functional Technical Liaison 

- Represent regional technical perspective in cross-functional initiatives with other CrowdStrike business units 
- Work directly with Product/Engineering to surface detection coverage gaps, platform bugs, and feature requests 
- Coordinate with OverWatch and Intelligence on regional threat trends 
- Partner with other Regional Principal Analysts on shared technical review standards and case QA criteria 
- Partner with Watchtower to drive detection tuning and coverage improvements based on regional intelligence. 

Thought Leadership & Market Engagement 

- Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, conference presentations, and other speaking events as appropriate

Strategic Projects & Innovation 

- Provide Technical expertise on regional projects that align with Falcon Complete mission and corporate goals 
- Drive innovation in detection gaps, triage, remediation, and automation capabilities 
- Collaborate with Section 3 (S3) AI Automation Team on regional automation opportunities 
- Identify and implement efficiency improvements with measurable regional impact 

Supervision & Autonomy 

- Works under minimal direction with high degree of autonomy 
- Works independently on technical matters 
- Expected to remain hands-on 
- Determines and pursues courses of action essential to achieving regional and corporate objectives 
- Provides consultative guidance to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership 

What You'll Need 

Successful candidates will have extensive experience in multiple of the following areas: 

- Incident Handling: expert-level experience leading and managing complex incident response investigations, including the ability to take ownership of high-severity, multi-host, and multi-customer incidents from triage through remediation. Proven experience investigating host/user compromises, organized crime groups, and sophisticated nation-state adversaries. 
- Threat Landscape Awareness: deep expertise in attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with advanced proficiency applying and extending MITRE ATT&CK to drive detection improvements and investigation strategies. 
- Computer Forensic Analysis: advanced experience conducting forensic analysis across host, memory, and network artifacts using a broad toolkit to determine full scope and root cause of compromise. 
- Malware Analysis: advanced ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis, including reverse engineering concepts and behavioral analysis. 
- Operating System Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of Windows, Mac, and/or Linux operating systems, with particular depth in at least one of these areas. 
- Systems Administration: advanced experience administering and securing enterprise network environments, with strong knowledge of IT architecture, authentication systems, and common attack paths across infrastructure. 
- Network Analysis Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of network protocols and traffic analysis, with the ability to identify attack patterns, lateral movement, and exfiltration in network data. 
- Identity Platform Awareness: deep expertise with identity and access management platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory, including advanced knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and credential abuse patterns. 
- Email Security Awareness: advanced experience investigating and remediating Microsoft 365 security incidents, including sophisticated business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attack chains. 
- Third-Party Log Analysis: advanced proficiency querying and correlating log sources across cloud platforms, network devices, identity providers, and email platforms within a SIEM environment to build detection logic and drive complex investigations. 
- Incident Remediation: proven expertise developing and executing strategic and surgical remediation plans for compromised environments, including complex multi-host and multi-platform scenarios with third-party containment coordination. 
- Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: expert-level understanding of secure network architecture with advanced hands-on experience navigating and troubleshooting enterprise network environments to support complex incident investigations. 
- Programming/Scripting: experience developing scripts and automation using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to build investigative tooling, automate remediation workflows, and expand detection and response capabilities. 
- AI Platforms: Experience working across various AI models, platforms, and tooling including MCP servers and agentic frameworks. Applies AI broadly across security operations — from investigation acceleration and workflow automation to internal capability development, prompt engineering, and driving AI adoption and maturity across the team. 
- Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. 

Education:
BA or BS / MA or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related field. Applicants without a degree but with relevant work experience and/or training will be considered.

description:

Senior Software Engineer, eRx Enterprise and Gadget 

About DrFirst

For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you’ll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!

Position Overview

DrFirst is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for the eRx Enterprise and Gadget team. Your first focus is Gadget, our pharmacy agent. Over time you will extend your work into Rcopia, our ePrescribing platform, on Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances (EPCS) and Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP) workflows.

You will build cloud native, high performance services for an ePrescribing collaboration platform. The platform connects providers, patients, payers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical companies in real time. You will design systems built for high load, with self healing, auto scaling, and full observability.

You bring strong judgment about AI. You know when AI speeds up delivery and when AI produces weak code. You apply AI to raise code quality, performance, and design standards across the team, and you solve real problems for the pharmacies and prescribers who rely on our platform.

What You Will Work On

- Build and improve Gadget, the DrFirst pharmacy agent, from design through production.
- Contribute to Rcopia EPCS and PDMP capabilities as the team roadmap expands.
- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable Java integration solutions.
- Build cloud native microservices on AWS with auto scaling, fault tolerance, high availability, and self healing.
- Develop and maintain integrations with major EHR platforms, including athenaOne, Epic, Oracle Health, Greenway, AdvancedMD, eMDs, and ModMed, using HL7, FHIR, web services, APIs, and Mirth Connect.
- Build and maintain event driven architectures with Apache Kafka for reliable, efficient service communication.
- Deliver high throughput and low latency across large, distributed platforms.
- Partner with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines that automate testing, deployment, and monitoring.
- Design AI powered automation frameworks for faster development cycles and automated regression testing.
- Decide where AI adds value in the codebase and where human design must lead. Set review standards for AI assisted code.
- Monitor, diagnose, and resolve performance issues with observability tools and logs.
- Follow and enforce secure coding practices. Take part in security audits and reviews.
- Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architecture decisions.
- Track industry trends and improve system performance, resilience, and developer productivity.

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
- 5+ years of hands on Java development with deep knowledge of object oriented design and the Spring Framework, including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
- 3+ years designing and building cloud native applications on AWS, including S3, Valkey, Lambda, RDS, and EKS or ECS.
- 3+ years with distributed messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, with a solid grasp of event streaming.
- Proven record building and integrating large scale, high performance, distributed systems with fault tolerance, scalability, and low latency.
- AI first mindset, with daily hands on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot for coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.
- Clear judgment on when and where AI improves engineering outcomes, and a record of keeping AI generated code from lowering quality, performance, or design.
- Proficiency building and consuming RESTful APIs with JSON and XML.
- Strong experience with relational or NoSQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and query optimization.
- Hands on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI and Jenkins.
- Solid knowledge of application and data security, including authentication, authorization, and data protection.
- Self motivated. You work well on your own in a fast paced, agile environment.
- Fast learner who adapts to new technologies, teams, and environments.
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proactive, solution oriented approach.

Preferred

- Experience building AI agents, LLM integrations, or agentic workflows in production.
- Experience with large scale, mission critical systems in finance, brokerage, trading, or credit card processing, especially systems requiring low latency, high throughput, and high availability.
- Experience with ePrescribing, EPCS, PDMP, NCPDP SCRIPT, or pharmacy systems.
- Familiarity with front end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

Physical Requirements

- Primarily desk work in a remote, U.S. based setting.
- Extended periods of computer use.

We’re obsessed with computers, programming, big data, databases, compilers, hardware, math, data science, and the internet. Does this sound like you? Please apply to join our team. Our codebase is friendly to new contributors. You’ll have a fully functional development environment within hours through full automation and will be pushing commits on your first day. Deployments to production happen multiple times per day and finish in under two minutes.Effectively all of our codebase is written in Python, Rust, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Nix. The core technologies you’ll need familiarity with to be productive are Python, PostgreSQL, Linux, and Git. We operate at a larger scale than typical startups. We run two datacenters with high-performance servers we’ve built ourselves, capable of handling the volumes of data we process. We’ve implemented our own distributed file system, perform full-scale web crawls, and download and run static analysis on the entire universe of published Android APKs and iOS IPAs. Unlike a typical startup where you might spend half your time in meetings and the other half fixing Jira tickets, at MixRank you’ll challenge yourself with difficult technical problems that help you grow as an individual. We’re continuously hiring for the positions below; these aren’t singular roles that close once filled. Our philosophy is that the candidate is more important than the position. For each new member of the team, we design a custom role and responsibilities around their interests.
Other companies may create a long list of specific requirements with the expectation that you’ll exactly replace someone on the team or fit a role defined by committee. MixRank is more pragmatic: we first get excited about bringing a unique individual onto the team, then figure out the best way to support their specific talents. ABOUT THE TEAM

The Canvas Core team builds and maintains the foundational platform that powers Mural’s visual thinking experience. This includes the infinite canvas, key editor components, document editing behaviors, asset management, real-time collaboration, and the systems that enable fast, reliable, and intuitive interaction on the canvas.

You’ll work on the systems that power real-time collaboration, shared document editing, spatial interactions, rendering and interaction performance, asset management, developer APIs, and AI-enabled product capabilities across the Mural editor.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 
Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with familiarity in React, Node.js, or comparable modern frameworks

- 
6+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

- 
Strong engineering judgment, with experience designing and delivering scalable, reliable, high-performance systems and developer-facing abstractions that balance simplicity, developer experience, and long-term maintainability

- 
Experience designing clean API contracts and service boundaries, including thoughtful data models, versioning, validation, error handling, documentation, and long-term maintainability

- 
Experience building distributed, concurrent, collaborative, or low-latency systems, such as collaboration tools, MMO games, shared-state systems, messaging protocols, or other low-latency user experiences, with familiarity across synchronization, consistency, event ordering, latency, failure modes, and performance trade-offs

Exposure to complex systems with rich object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, selection mechanics, and performance-sensitive user interactions is a strong plus

Interest in AI-enabled product capabilities, or hands-on experience building or integrating them in production, such as intelligent editing, automation, recommendations, semantic document understanding, or collaboration features powered by AI

- 
Performance optimization experience, including profiling, bottleneck analysis, memory and CPU efficiency, latency reduction, and responsiveness as document complexity and user activity scale

- 
Familiarity with parallel processing, off-main-thread architectures, rendering pipelines, background computation, or other multithreaded systems is a plus

- 
Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure engineering work

- 
Communication and collaboration skills, with a low-ego approach to working with Product, Design, and Engineering, and the ability to contribute meaningfully to technical discussions, collaborate across teams, and help improve team engineering practices

- 
Comfort operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments or scale-ups is a plus

title: Tech Lead - Python & AI
description:
This is a full-time, permanent opportunity for candidates based in the UK and authorised to work without sponsorship. 

This position also requires travel to client sites with travel expenses covered by the company .

About Nearform 

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart. 

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products. 
Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role: 

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

- Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.

- Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.

- Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.

- Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.

- Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.

- Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.

- Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person: 

- Significant experience in software engineering and 2+ years of experience leading projects and mentoring as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, we are looking for professional experience Python.

- Experience with AI application development and Agentic frameworks and platforms (e.g., LangGraph, Agentspace, etc.)

- Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.

- Proven experience working with Kubernetes for container orchestration.

- Strong CI/CD experience, including hands-on work with Terraform, Helm, and other cloud-native IaC technologies.

- Deep understanding of observability practices, with practical experience using OpenTelemetry (OTel) and related tooling.

- Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.

- Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.

- Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.

- Deep understanding of version control tools, e.g. Git.

- Understanding of DevOps practices and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)

- Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)

- Empathy and people skills

Benefits and Perks we offer at Nearform 

- Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance. 

- Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem! 

- Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.

- Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.

- Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.

- Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.

- Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process 

- Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
An initial conversation with a member of our Talent Team to explore your background, leadership experience, and career goals. We’ll provide an overview of Nearform, discuss potential alignment, and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

- Panel Interview (60 mins via Zoom)
A conversation with two of our Technical Directors focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

- Technical Lead Assessment (90 mins via Zoom)
A structured assessment led by a senior Technical Lead or Head of Engineering, designed to evaluate key aspects of a Technical Lead role. This session includes a selection of tasks to cover:
Architecture Design - We want to see how you approach a high-level problem, demonstrating your design thinking and decision-making process.
Technical Implementation - How do you turn a design into reality, taking into account business needs?
Code Standards and Feedback - We want to see not just your own skills, but also how you improve those around you

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project. 

Ready to Join Us? 

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees. 

Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence. 

If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help. 

O ur salary range starts from £90,000 + bonus & benefits and will be discussed during the initial interview based on your experience.

Early sessions are for breaking the product down together. After that, scope is deliverable by deliverable. ABOUT THE STUDIO:
We are a small Bay Area product studio. Several products, one stack, one visual language. You own the UX with us: who the user is, what they are trying to finish, what belongs on each screen, and what happens when it fails. Later products reuse the same tokens, components, and patterns so customers and our engineers are not learning a new UI every time. The products are B2B web apps: dashboards, media and content libraries, status views, and auth and access-gate states. The first product in the queue is a digital signage CMS. Store owners upload content, build playlists, pair outdoor Android screens from a phone, and see what is playing. The app is a mobile-first PWA. The screen on the sidewalk has its own states: setup QR, downloading, no content, and error. You take a real part in that breakdown. Bring a point of view on structure, priority, and what to cut. Sit with us and map the flows before the high-fidelity screens exist. When a familiar admin layout is the wrong job for the task, say so and show the alternative. The screens still have to ship. We start from a Tailwind UI / shadcn component kit. Buttons, inputs, tables, cards, and dialogs stay that anatomy, restyled with our brand: color, type, radius, and density. Page structure, hierarchy, and flow are yours. Every screen is composed from those components, with tokens that map to our Tailwind theme, so the frontend team builds from the system. FOR MORE DETAILS OR TO APPLY: https://vuetech.sh/careers

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits 

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

- Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

- Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

- Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

- Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

- Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

- 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

- You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

- You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

- You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

- You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

- You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

This is an Atlantic portfolio company. 

What we're building 

Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. We build AI software that helps production engineers and operators turn machine data into answers: why a line is slowing down, what's causing scrap, and what to fix next. We're early and in stealth. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding core team.

You're the person who makes our product work in the real world. You go into a plant, figure out what's actually broken, connect the data, and stay until operators use the product every day without being asked. You'll work with everyone from the machine operator to the plant manager, and with IT and OT. You own each customer from the first conversation through rollout and expansion. Berlin or home-based in Germany, with regular time in Berlin with the team. You'll spend about 20% of your time at customer sites.

- Run the project with the customer and our commercial lead: plans, workshops, validation sessions, and success criteria

- Find the next machine, line, data source, or use case, and expand with it

- Bring what you learn in the field back to the product, so each deployment makes the platform better

- Help write the playbook for how we deliver, as the customer engineering team grows

- Have worked hands-on with industrial machines and production processes, in manufacturing, automation, maintenance, quality, industrial engineering, or industrial data

- Are happy to travel to customer sites and have a driver's license

A degree is optional. A Meister, Techniker, vocational training, or real-world experience counts just as much. We care about what you can do.
